构成、并把自身规则强加于流通的空间之间。流通空间以及赋予物以某种特定身份的特定交换体系这一观念，是朝着“过程物品”迈出的第一步。要成为商品，物必须被从其附着于其中的世界撕扯出来并迁移，然后重新分配给一个新的世界。某些移动、某些从一个领域到另一个领域、从一个空间到另一个空间的过渡，被弄得不可能或代价极高。于是，某些物品或某些存在者不可交换。它们必须被保留，而它们也确实被保留下来。再举一个经济学家喜爱的例子：在当代社会，对父母不满的孩子，即便想摆脱父母、用他们换更好的父亲或母亲，或把他们卖给任何愿意买的人，也会遇到真正的困难。在法国这样的国家，儿童（以及父母）的商品化是禁忌：人们可以收养他们，但不能购买他们。

The idea of spheres of circulation shows that there is nothing in a thing that prevents it from becoming a commodity, or, on the contrary, destines it to do so. However, this idea is far from satisfactory. The arbitrary nature of things is replaced with more arbitrariness: someone from the society or culture is responsible for this sorting. In speaking of binarism, Jane Guyer has given a good summary of these limits.

According to her, evoking the existence of specialized spheres of exchange assumes that one could establish clear and definite distinctions between them, as well as between the goods involved, distinctions that always end up opposing two terms of a pair, market relations and community relations. Moreover, adds Guyer, such a vision seriously misunderstands the network of exchanges and transactions that any collective maintains with the outside world.
流通空间这一观念表明，物本身没有任何东西阻止它成为商品，或者相反，注定它成为商品。然而，这一观念远不能令人满意。物的任意性被更多的任意性取代：社会或文化中的某个人负责进行这种分类。简·盖耶（Jane Guyer）在谈论二元论时，很好地总结了这些局限。
在她看来，援引专门化交换领域的存在，预设人们能够在这些领域之间、以及在所涉物品之间，确立清晰而确定的区分；这些区分最终总是把一对术语对立起来，即市场关系与共同体关系。此外，盖耶补充说，这样一种视野严重误解了任何集体与外部世界所维持的交换与交易网络。

The binarism is useful because it protects thought from naturalism. However, it also introduces an equally difficult problem. How are these separations produced? Although such exclusions are often empirically observable, binarism fails to raise the important question of the mechanisms that organize this distribution, ensure its continued existence, or, on the contrary, more or less sporadically cast them in doubt. If and when they exist, how are these spheres instituted, sustained, transformed? Binarism ultimately endows these structures with a deus ex machina(social environment, institutions, social norms, culture, or the sacred), a constraining force that is recorded, but not explained. Where does this force come from? How is one to account for the fact that it fades out at certain moments, only to return later in a new form? The market-nonmarket binarism imposes structural constraints, which are generally imputed to culture or values, that it never explains or analyzes.

二元论是有用的，因为它保护思想免受自然主义侵害。然而，它也引入了一个同样困难的问题：这些分离是如何产生的？尽管这类排斥往往可以在经验中观察到，二元论却没有提出一个重要问题：是什么机制组织这种分配、确保其持续存在，或者相反，或多或少零星地使其受到怀疑？如果这些领域存在，它们是如何被建制、维持和转化的？二元论最终赋予这些结构一个解围之神（deus ex machina，即社会环境、制度、社会规范、文化或神圣者），一种被记录下来却未得到解释的约束力量。这种力量从何而来？如何解释它在某些时刻消退、随后又以新的形式回归？市场—非市场的二元论强加了结构性约束，人们通常把这些约束归因于文化或价值，而它从未解释或分析这些约束。
FROM SPHERES TO TRAJECTORIES: A MATTER OF CAREERS

One way to escape is to not focus on the spheres themselves, but on the objects or goods that refuse to circulate in the spheres that are supposed to keep them captive. Guyer, revisiting the terrain Bohannan explored, notes that conversions between spheres are more frequent than one thinks, that they happen at any moment in any place, and that it is difficult to sustain that these spaces of circulation are sealed off from one another. If one moves to Western societies, it is impossible not to notice that an entity such as blood seems to resist commodity status under certain circumstances. Blood endlessly transforms as it circulates. In some places, it is a noncommercial entity, and elsewhere in the same society, under the form of plasma or transformed blood products, it is a market commodity.
从领域到轨迹：生涯问题

一条出路是，不把焦点放在领域本身，而放在那些不肯只在本应将其禁锢其中的领域内流通的物或物品上。盖耶重新审视博安南探索过的领域，指出领域之间的转换比人们想象的更频繁，它们随时随地都在发生，而且很难坚持认为这些流通空间彼此密封隔绝。如果转向西方社会，就不可能不注意到，像血液这样的实体在某些情况下似乎抵抗商品身份。血液在流通中不断转化。在某些地方，它是非商业性实体；而在同一社会的另一些地方，以血浆或经过转化的血液制品的形式，它又是市场商品。

Drawing on this observation, Arjun Appadurai and his colleagues applied the notion of “career” to things. The term is usually used to describe the trajectory of human beings moving (more or less voluntarily) from one position to another.

These authors tell us that if one simply brackets the agents between whose hands a thing passes and the social spaces they are supposed to travel through, if one observes the states things occupy as though one were a physicist following the traces of particles in a bubble chamber, it becomes manifest that the zigzagging trajectories of things cross supposedly impermeable borders.
阿尔君·阿帕杜莱（Arjun Appadurai）及其同事借鉴这一观察，把“生涯”概念应用于物。该词通常用来描述人（或多或少自愿地）从一个位置移动到另一个位置的轨迹。
这些作者告诉我们，如果人们干脆把物在其间易手的行动者、以及这些物被认为应当穿行的社会空间加括号括起来，如果人们像物理学家追踪气泡室中的粒子径迹那样观察物所占据的状态，就会清楚地看到：物那曲折蜿蜒的轨迹穿越了据说不可渗透的边界。
Written in 1988,
The Social Life of Things

is full of examples borrowed from different societies and eras. The story of how relics develop is particularly instructive. A fragment of a human body transforms into a relic only at the end of a long route that often starts with thefts and pillage. Being forcibly taken institutes and attests to its value and ends with the organization of more or less illicit markets. What might one say of those masks or statues, sacred objects within the African societies that produce them, that first circulate in closed circuits, only to end their career, after multiple adventures, exhibited in the display cases of North American museums or in a halo of light in the dark rooms of the Quai Branly Museum in Paris and are then reproduced in glossy art books that gush endlessly about their magical powers? And what of those statues blasted out by Daesh that show up in private collections before being bought up,
morale oblige

, by museums that will, sooner or later, be ordered to return them to their countries of origin? The Aristotelian world of spheres and circular orbits has gone haywire; goods follow unpredictable trajectories. The closed world that turns on itself gives way to infinite space and open trajectories.
《物的社会生命》（
The Social Life of Things

）写于1988年，充满借自不同社会与时代的例子。圣髑如何形成的故事尤其富有教益。人体的一块残片，只有在经历一条往往以盗窃和劫掠开始的漫长路途之后，才转化为圣髑。被强行取走这一事实确立并证明了它的价值，而这一过程最终以多少带有非法性质的市场的组织告终。那些面具或雕像又该如何说呢？它们在产出它们的非洲社会里是神圣之物，最初在封闭的圈子中流通，历经多次奇遇之后，最终结束其生涯，被陈列在北美博物馆的展柜里，或在巴黎凯布朗利博物馆（Musée du Quai Branly）幽暗展厅的一束光晕中，随后又被复制进光鲜的艺术画册，那些画册滔滔不绝地盛赞其魔力。还有那些被达伊沙（Daesh）炸出、后来出现在私人收藏中的雕像，又该如何说呢？它们随后被博物馆买下——
道义使然
——而这些博物馆迟早会被命令将它们归还原产国。亚里士多德式的天球与圆轨道世界已经失控；物品遵循不可预测的轨迹。那个自我旋转的封闭世界，让位于无限空间与开放轨迹。

These are general mechanisms that do not apply exclusively to the most culturally sensitive objects. To be convinced that all things have complex trajectories, one need only think of trash and the sorting and recycling operations to which it has given rise. After it is consigned to the correctly marked bin, the newspaper or magazine you bought and perhaps read finds itself in a circuit in which it changes status several times; it may be ultimately consigned as worthless waste, or, on the contrary, it may be transformed into a potentially valuable material that reenters commercial circuits or the circuits of a circular economy. Some waste is even transformed into authentic works of art, such as compressed car wrecks taken from dumps, which were first exhibited by César in 1960 at the Musée d’Art Moderne de la Ville de Paris. The old fridge you put out on the sidewalk to be picked up as trash might be of interest to someone who needs one to tide them over. A friend of mine, a connoisseur in hand-knotted rugs who lives in a wealthy suburb, has collected magnificent specimens that their owners, no doubt unaware of their value (or secretly generous), put out on the street.

这些是普遍机制，并不只适用于最具文化敏感性的物品。要相信所有物都有复杂轨迹，只需想想垃圾，以及垃圾引发的分拣与回收作业。你买来、也许读过的报纸或杂志，在被丢进标记正确的垃圾桶之后，便进入一个多次改变身份的循环；它最终可能被当作毫无价值的废弃物处理掉，或者相反，被转化为一种潜在有价值的材料，重新进入商业循环或循环经济的循环。有些垃圾甚至被转化为真正的艺术品，例如从垃圾场取来的压缩汽车残骸，塞萨尔（César）于1960年首次在巴黎市立现代艺术博物馆（Musée d’Art Moderne de la Ville de Paris）展出它们。你放在人行道上等人当垃圾收走的旧冰箱，也许会引起某个需要一台冰箱暂渡难关的人的兴趣。我有一位朋友，是住在富裕郊区的专家级手工打结地毯鉴赏家，他收集了若干精美绝伦的样本——它们的主人无疑不知道其价值（或者暗中慷慨），把它们放到了街上。

The career of radioactive substances provides the most spectacular and controversial example of trajectories. Some, intermediate or highly active, are destined to be forgotten, ending up as ultimate waste in underground shafts, locked into the clay of the Champagne region for several hundred thousand years. Others, such as those used as fuels, are considered potentially valuable material, recycled to start a new life in nuclear plants specially designed to reprocess them. Geographer Romain Garcier has followed the trajectories of these different substances, whose classifications and destinies are constantly evolving.

Some are sent to Siberia without hope of return, while others come back transformed in order to participate in generating energy. Things are never at rest. The more that innovations multiply, the more they proliferate, the more cumbersome they become, and the more often they are ordered to change place, to transform, to hide away, without being able to disappear completely. The ultimate radioactive waste that has to be buried once and for all continues to trouble local residents’ sleep. Things are not attached to social spaces that define their status as the planets of the solar system are set in their orbits. When you follow a good, you see it constantly change state: one moment, it is a commercial good, the next, a present offered to anonymous recipients or a scrap thrown into a waste site, then once again inserted into a market cycle, sometimes diverted, stolen, as relics once were and radioactive materials still are, before entering a sacred sphere where, as Annette Weiner and Maurice Godelier tell it, they come to rest, at least for a while.

The plutonium that may be buried five hundred meters down in Bure, a small village in the east of France, could, due to its long-term radioactivity, reach that improbable status, buried for eternity in impregnable galleries.
放射性物质的生涯，为轨迹提供了最壮观、也最具争议的例子。有些放射性物质——中等放射性或高放射性的——注定被遗忘，最终作为终极废物落入地下竖井，被封存在香槟地区的黏土中数十万年。另一些，例如用作燃料的那些，则被视为潜在有价值的材料，经过回收，在专为再处理它们而设计的核电站中开始新生活。地理学家罗曼·加尔西耶（Romain Garcier）追踪了这些不同物质的轨迹，它们的分类与命运不断演变。

有些被送往西伯利亚，再无回归的希望；另一些则经过转化后返回，参与能源生产。物从不休息。创新越是成倍增加、物越是增殖，它们就越是难以处置，也越频繁地被命令改变位置、转化、藏匿起来，却无法彻底消失。必须一劳永逸地埋掉的终极放射性废物，继续搅扰当地居民的睡眠。物并不像太阳系的行星被固定在轨道上那样，附着于界定其身份的社会空间。当你追随一件物品时，你会看到它不断改变状态：这一刻它是商业物品，下一刻它是献给匿名接受者的礼物，或被扔进垃圾场的废料，随后又再次被插入市场循环，有时被转移、被盗——正如圣髑曾经、放射性材料如今仍遭遇的那样——然后进入一个神圣领域；按照安妮特·韦纳（Annette Weiner）与莫里斯·戈德利耶（Maurice Godelier）的说法，它们在那里安顿下来，至少暂时如此。
可能被埋在法国东部小村比尔（Bure）地下五百米深处的钚，由于其长期放射性，或许会达到那种不可思议的身份：在无法攻破的坑道中永远被埋葬。

Things are not the only entities that are subject to these incessant metamorphoses. It is no coincidence that Appadurai appeals to notions such as career or biography. He could just as well have opted for curriculum vitae, which applies indifferently to the life of a university professor or a piece of plutonium. Professors sometimes provide classes for which they are paid. At other moments, they offer services for free to nonprofit associations. Eventually, they, too, must be retired, even if they are not compressed and buried just yet! The existence of things and people can be described, narrated, converted into stories; the discourses of which they are the heroes contribute to shaping their careers.

物并非唯一经受这些无休止变形的实体。阿帕杜莱诉诸“生涯”或“传记”之类的概念，并非偶然。他完全可以选用“履历”（curriculum vitae）一词，这个词同样适用于一位大学教授或一块钚的生命。教授有时讲授有报酬的课程，另一些时候则向非营利协会免费提供服务。最终，他们也必须退休，尽管他们还不至于被压缩并埋掉！物与人的存在可以被描述、被叙述、被转化为故事；那些以它们为主角的话语，参与塑造了它们的生涯。

Imagine for a moment that you could back away to a distant viewpoint and contemplate the circulation of the goods that surround us, those that make up ordinary life. Imagine you were then attentive to the trajectories they follow and the transformations to which they are subjected over the course of their circulation. You would quickly be convinced that things have something to do with manufacturing their own destiny, for they are not susceptible to the same transformations, nor are the same careers open to them, depending on whether they are human fragments, plastic bottles, richly embroidered cloth, pieces of plutonium, or a painting. If the careers of a relic, a piece of textile, an aluminum can, a car, or a work of art are so different, it is because they depend, at least in part, on the qualities and characteristics accumulated by these objects along the way. Their history and their material matter.

不妨暂时想象，你退到一个遥远的视点，凝望环绕我们的物品、构成日常生活的物品的流通。再想象你留意它们所遵循的轨迹，以及它们在流通过程中经受的转化。你很快就会相信，物在某种程度上参与制造自己的命运：因为视其是人体残片、塑料瓶、刺绣精美的布料、钚块还是一幅画而定，它们所能承受的转化不同，向它们敞开的生涯也不同。如果圣髑、一块织物、一只铝罐、一辆汽车或一件艺术品的生涯如此不同，那是因为它们至少部分取决于这些对象沿途积累的品质与特征。它们的历史与它们的物质都举足轻重。

The essential contribution of economic anthropology is to underline the unstable and shaky status of goods: they are not destined to turn in circles, like caged animals. Its other merit is to suggest that the lives of goods are not totally independent of their progressively acquired qualities and, notably, their material qualities, just as human beings’ careers are not completely independent of their dispositions. Bohannan invites us to shift our way of looking so as to focus on things and their circulation. Appadurai and his colleagues go further. They shatter the spheres and introduce greater realism in the description of the trajectories. At the same time, they have indirectly staged the role materiality plays as it interferes in the dynamic of displacements and changes of status.

经济人类学的根本贡献，在于强调物品身份的不稳定与摇摇欲坠：物品并不像关在笼中的动物那样，注定原地打转。它的另一项功绩，是暗示物品的生命并非完全独立于它们逐步获得的品质，尤其是其物质品质；正如人的生涯也并非完全独立于其禀性。博安南邀请我们转变观看方式，把焦点放在物及其流通上。阿帕杜莱及其同事走得更远。他们打碎了领域，在轨迹描述中引入了更多现实主义。与此同时，他们间接地让物质性登场，显示它如何介入位移与身份变化的动态。
DISENTANGLING THINGS FROM A DENSITY OF ASSOCIATIONS
从关联的密度中解缠事物

Considering the career of things constitutes a decisive step forward. It shows that goods are not eventually destined to be objects of market transactions by virtue of a social logic that is beyond them or because of the space in which they move. Rather, they are participants in market transactions only at certain moments, and the possibility of being framed as commodities is constantly under threat by forces that push them to branch off and lead them to change status and state. This analysis, and the outcome it leads to, are crucial. However, they do not reach inside the mechanisms of these transformations or further our understanding of them. Some explanations are eliminated, but the question remains: Which forces rip things out in one state and dissolve them in another?

考察物的生涯构成了决定性的一步。它表明，物品并非凭借某种外在于它们的社会逻辑，也不是因为它们所流通的空间，才最终注定成为市场交易的对象。相反，它们只是在某些时刻才参与市场交易，而它们被框定为商品的可能性，始终受到各种力量的威胁——这些力量推动它们分岔，使它们改变身份与状态。这一分析及其引出的结果至关重要。然而，它们并未深入这些转变的机制内部，也未能增进我们对这些机制的理解。某些解释被排除了，但问题依然存在：究竟是哪些力量把物从一种状态中撕扯出来，又在另一种状态中将其消解？

The importance of this question has not escaped some of the anthropologists or sociologists who have extended the work of Appadurai and colleagues. Starting from the idea that changes in status do not fall from the sky and that things do not move forward on their own, they have focused their attention on the processes that accompany changes of state, those processes that mold things, profile them, and set them into motion. How do things get displaced, adjusted, modified?
这一问题的重要性，并未逃过一些扩展了阿帕杜莱（Arjun Appadurai）及其同僚工作的社会学家或人类学家的注意。他们从这样一个观念出发：身份的变化不会从天而降，物也不会自行向前运动；因此，他们把注意力集中于伴随状态变化的那些过程，那些塑造物、赋予物以轮廓并使之运转起来的过程。物是如何被移动、调整、改造的？

An important step forward was taken by Annette Weiner when she turned her attention to the existence of inalienable possessions, that is to say, entities that resist, in some circumstances, all forms of exchange and circulation. To explain certain objects’ capacity to come to a standstill, she proposes the idea of “social density.” As she puts it, the greater the social density of an object, the harder it is to set it into motion. Rather than moving from hand to hand, it stays attached to the person who owns it. According to her, and reformulated in my own vocabulary, this density is the result of a set of associations that, when they are strong, numerous, and durable, weigh the thing down. In the end, these associations condemn it to a form of immobility, thereby imposing a stable status. Weiner thus talks about the narrow connection made between the thing and the person in whose possession it is, its past history, and the resulting attachments, of the secret that surrounds its existence and renders it sometimes elusive, and so on. There are many possible connections of many types. If nothing is done to organize and facilitate its disentangling, the thing ends up being a stakeholder in the person or group of people to which it has been attached. Dense objects move slowly. Conversely, objects whose density is lower are likely to be put into circulation.

安妮特·韦纳（Annette Weiner）迈出了重要的一步：她把注意力转向不可让渡的占有物（inalienable possessions），也就是在某些情形下抵抗一切交换与流通形式的实体。为了解释某些物件何以能够停驻不动，她提出了“社会密度”（social density）的观念。照她所说，一个物件的社会密度越大，就越难以使之运动起来。它不会从一只手传到另一只手，而是始终附着于拥有它的那个人。按照她的说法——并用我自己的词汇重新表述——这种密度是一组关联的结果；当这些关联强烈、众多且持久时，它们便使物沉重不堪。最终，这些关联把它判定为某种不动的状态，从而强加给它一个稳定的身份。韦纳由此谈到物与其占有者之间建立的紧密联系、物过去的历史以及由此产生的附着，谈到围绕其存在并使之有时难以捉摸的秘密，如此等等。可能的联系很多，类型也多种多样。如果不做任何事去组织和促成它的解缠，物最终会成为它所附着的那个人或群体中的一名利益攸关者。致密的物移动缓慢。反过来，密度较低的物则很可能被投入流通。

Weiner gives the example of the coats worn by Maori women. These coats are attached to the lineage and transcend the people who wear them. One could easily transpose this to contemporary societies. The careers of certain entities have them so entangled with the people who possess them that separation can only be difficult, violent, and painful. Connections have been woven; the associations established have progressively become very intense. The density has grown constantly: “I cannot shed this; it will break my heart. . . .”
韦纳举了毛利（Maori）妇女所穿外套的例子。这些外套附着于世系，并超越穿戴它们的人。人们可以轻而易举地把这一点移用到当代社会。某些实体的生涯使它们与占有它们的人如此纠缠，以至于分离只能是困难的、暴力的和痛苦的。联系已被编织起来；所建立的关联逐渐变得非常强烈。密度不断增长：“我无法摆脱这个；它会让我心碎……”

The point I am interested in is the one Weiner adds. The density that measures the tendency to immobility (or mobility) is not a property intrinsic to things, since it depends on the associations or connections through which they have gradually been constituted. Relying upon this, I would conclude that if children cannot exchange and sell their parents, it is because the attachments are numerous and strong and oppose separation. Similarly, if certain elements of scientific knowledge sometimes resist those who would sell them, it is because they constitute only an addition to a larger set of results with which, according to some, they remain irrevocably associated, so that detaching them is impossible. If the commercialization of human tissue provokes indignation, it is because it is not easy to separate it from those from whom it has been drawn and who consider it an integral and inalienable part of their identity. It would not add much intelligibility to say — and on this point I part ways with Weiner — that these resistances are cultural, that they depend on values or moral convictions. If children and their parents are intensely attached to one another, if scientific texts are so strongly connected to all those that preceded them, if cells have a hard time being detached from bodies, it is because throughout these entangled existences, connections have been woven that, like warp and weft, combine these elements to produce a single piece of seamless fabric; inroads into it can be made only by tearing it. What I take from Weiner is a very simple, but fundamental point: that it is essential to pay attention to the connections, to how these are established or undone, to consider their strength and not their supposed origins.

我感兴趣的是韦纳补充的那一点。衡量不动（或流动）倾向的密度，并不是物内在固有的属性，因为它取决于物借以逐渐被构成的那些关联或联系。据此，我会得出结论：如果说子女不能交换和出售父母，那是因为附着众多而强烈，反对分离。同样，如果说某些科学知识的要素有时抵抗那些想要出售它们的人，那是因为它们仅仅构成更大一组结果的追加部分，而据某些人说，它们与这组结果保持着不可撤销的关联，因此把它们分离出来是不可能的。如果说人体组织的商品化激起愤慨，那是因为并不容易把它与那些被抽取组织的人分开——这些人把组织视为自己身份中不可分割、不可让渡的一部分。说这些抵抗是文化的，说它们取决于价值或道德信念，并不会增加多少可理解性——在这一点上我与韦纳分道扬镳。如果说子女与父母彼此强烈附着，如果说科学文本与先前所有文本联系得如此紧密，如果说细胞难以从身体上脱离，那是因为在这些纠缠的存在中，联系被编织起来，像经线与纬线一样把这些要素组合成一整块无缝的织物；要进入其中，只能把它撕开。我从韦纳那里得到的，是一个非常简单却根本的要点：必须关注联系，关注联系如何建立或解除，关注它们的力量，而不是它们假定的起源。

The density of associations and attachments, which are not external to things but constitute their very matter and substance, much as successive layers built up by a 3-D printer gradually shape an object, can vary continuously, depending on the connections that are made or unmade, depending on time and interactions. These variations explain how changes of states can be produced in ways that are not necessarily sudden or dramatic. The simple mechanism of relative densities moves us away from the market-nonmarket binarism that Guyer rightly criticizes and the scenography that Appadurai reimagines, a scenography that, although it abandons the existence of borders between sealed-off spaces, does endorse the hypothesis that there is an exclusive opposition between the different possible states.

The notion of density allows one to understand why the changes are not necessarily brutal. What counts is not so much the existence of separate and distinct states, but the gradual process whereby density is transformed. A thing detaches, sometimes slowly, sometimes rapidly. It can then enter an exchange and, if it detaches even more and in a particular way, become a candidate for commodification.

关联与附着并不外在于物，而是构成物本身的质料与实质，正如 3D 打印机逐层堆积、逐渐塑造出一个物件；这些关联与附着的密度可以连续变化，取决于联系被建立或被解除，取决于时间与互动。这些变化解释了状态的变化何以能够以并非必然突然或戏剧性的方式产生。相对密度的简单机制使我们远离盖耶（Jane Guyer）正确地批评的市场—非市场二元论，也远离阿帕杜莱重新构想的场景设计——这种场景设计虽然放弃了封闭空间之间存在边界的设定，却认可了不同可能状态之间存在排他性对立的假设。
密度的概念使人能够理解，为什么这些变化未必是剧烈的。重要的与其说是分离而独特的状态之存在，不如说是密度被转化的渐进过程。物脱离开来，有时缓慢，有时迅速。它随后可以进入一种交换；如果它脱离得更多，并且以某种特定方式脱离，它就可以成为商品化的候选者。

Describing density as merely “social” runs the risk of allowing it to be forgotten that the material properties of objects count as much as those usually described as social. The successive layers mentioned earlier are obviously both social and material. (A 3-D printer manufactures composite materials!) It is easy to break free from this opposition by speaking of sociotechnical density (or more simply, of just density), which includes any kind of ties. In fact, Weiner observes that a thing will enter more or less easily into a type of exchange or mobility, depending on whether it is more or less hard, divisible or unbreakable, perishable or immutable, heavy or light, changing with time, reproducible, vulnerable, fragile, easily lost — all properties that have to do with certain arrangements of atoms and molecules. The social nature of density is unquestionable if, and only if, one understands the term “social” (
socius

, association) in the sense given to it by Bruno Latour. He uses the term in a way that allowed him to change the very meaning of the word “society” by showing that it is the associations and connections that count — all the associations and all the connections, whatever their nature.

仅仅把密度描述为“社会的”，有可能使人忘记：物的物质属性与那些通常被描述为社会的属性同样重要。前面提到的逐层堆积显然既是社会的，也是物质的。（3D 打印机制造的是复合材料！）只要谈论社会技术密度（或者更简单地说，密度），就可以轻松摆脱这种对立，因为这一说法包含任何类型的联系。事实上，韦纳观察到，一个物进入某种交换或流动的难易程度，取决于它较硬还是较软、可分割还是不可破碎、易腐还是不变、重还是轻、是否随时间变化、是否可复制、是否易受损、是否脆弱、是否容易丢失——所有这些属性都与原子和分子的某种排列方式有关。密度的社会性质是无可置疑的，当且仅当人们按照布鲁诺·拉图尔（Bruno Latour）赋予“社会的”（
socius
，关联）一词的含义来理解它。他使用这个词的方式，使他得以改变“社会”一词本身的含义：他表明，真正重要的是关联与联系——所有的关联和所有的联系，无论其性质如何。

Some anthropologists intuited this in their studies devoted to societies far removed from us in both time and space. In his work devoted to Indonesian society, Webb Keane follows the career of a piece of fabric that moves from being a banner proudly flown, to the vehicle for insulting a hereditary enemy, to the means of appeasing an irritated client, or, again, into a metaphor for poverty. As he notes, this versatility and the significations it authorizes depend directly on the material characteristics of the thing, which lends itself, as one can so fittingly say, to these successive reinterpretations, each interpretation intersecting with its material qualities.

It therefore makes no sense, according to him, and we can only agree on this point, to separate what belongs to the order of the social or the cultural, which would explain why the changes in state and status are possible, and what belongs to the order of the material and of functionalities. Yes, associations are at the heart of things themselves, of their being and their destiny, but they are neither social, nor symbolic, nor material, nor physical, but all of these at the same time. The thing constitutes a nexus of connections and associations, and on condition that one does not distinguish a priori among these associations, those that are social and those that are not, one can even assert that it is only that. It is transformed and requalified depending on the associations into which it enters.

一些人类学家在致力于研究那些在时间与空间上都远离我们的社会时，直觉到了这一点。韦布·基恩（Webb Keane）在其研究印度尼西亚社会的工作中，追踪了一块织物的生涯：它从一面自豪地飘扬的旗帜，变成侮辱世仇的工具，又变成安抚一位恼怒客户的手段，或者再次变成贫穷的隐喻。正如他指出的，这种多用途性以及它所允许的意涵，直接取决于物的物质特性；人们可以非常恰当地说，物本身就适合这些接连不断的重新解释，而每一种解释都与其物质品质相交织。

因此，在他看来——在这一点上我们只能表示同意——把属于社会或文化秩序的东西（据说它可以解释状态与身份的变化何以可能）与属于物质和功能秩序的东西分开，是毫无意义的。是的，关联位于物本身的核心，位于其存在与命运的核心，但它们既不是社会的，也不是象征的，既不是物质的，也不是物理的，而是同时属于所有这些。物构成了联系与关联的一个纽结；只要人们不先验地区分这些关联中哪些是社会的、哪些不是，甚至可以断言，物就仅仅是这个纽结。它根据自己所进入的关联而被转化、被重新界定品质。

For a good to be able to travel from one site to another, it must be transferable, that is to say, movable. If its density is too great, if the elements it associates are too narrowly and too definitively tied to one another, the transfer becomes problematic. It is at this point, the point at which things are about to be (re)formatted in order to be able to circulate, that it is useful to introduce the notion of
disentanglement
proposed by Nicholas Thomas.
物品要能够从一个场所旅行到另一个场所，就必须是可转移的，也就是说，是可移动的。如果它的密度过大，如果它所关联的要素彼此联系得过于紧密、过于确定，转移就会成为问题。正是在这个时刻——物即将为了能够流通而被（重新）格式化——引入尼古拉斯·托马斯（Nicholas Thomas）提出的
解缠
概念才是有用的。

The Volkswagen Golf I have just acquired, whether I bought it or it was given to me, would be of no use to me without the network of highways, garages, gas stations, without those oil companies that fight to preserve their monopolies on the Iraqi oil rigs and have no compunction spewing the carbon that lay under the earth for millennia into the atmosphere, without insurance companies, without driving associations, driving schools, traffic rules or police to enforce them. This environment is what Gilbert Simondon suggests calling the
associated milieu
, and all goods require one. A completely disentangled good, one for which all the associations that constitute it had been undone, could no longer function.
The good would no longer exist and would simply disappear.
我刚刚获得的那辆大众高尔夫（Volkswagen Golf），无论是我买的还是别人送的，如果没有高速公路网、修车厂、加油站，没有那些为保住伊拉克油田垄断权而争斗、并且毫无顾忌地把在地下埋藏了数千年的碳喷入大气的石油公司，没有保险公司，没有驾驶协会、驾校、交通规则或执行规则的警察，它对我都毫无用处。这个环境就是吉尔贝·西蒙东（Gilbert Simondon）建议称之为关联环境（
associated milieu
）的东西，而一切物品都需要一个关联环境。一个完全解缠的物品——构成它的所有关联都已被解除——将不再能够运作。
这个物品将不再存在，只会简单地消失。

The associated milieu, whose characteristics narrowly depend on the particular object, is made necessary by the object itself, whose conditions of existence it ensures in return. The associated milieu is not limited to a simple technological infrastructure.

It is more like a nourishing milieu. Without that milieu, the Golf I bought would be condemned to immobility and would be of no use to me. The usage rights that Volkswagen sells me can be effective only if the associated milieu that authorizes the corresponding actions is available and can be mobilized at any moment. Buying a car that one cannot drive is, of course, conceivable, but it is not likely that the market for such a good would have a sustainable future.
关联环境的特征紧密依赖于特定物件；正是物件本身使这一环境成为必要，而环境反过来又确保物件的存在条件。关联环境并不局限于简单的技术基础设施。
它更像是一个滋养性的环境。没有这个环境，我买的那辆高尔夫就注定无法移动，对我毫无用处。大众卖给我的使用权，只有在授权相应行动的关联环境可得、并能在任何时刻被调动起来时，才可能有效。买一辆自己不能开的车，当然可以想象，但这样一种物品的市场不太可能拥有可持续的未来。

This analysis is not limited to so-called material objects. It can be extended to all services. The caregiver who comes to my house to take care of my little girl can do their job only if the elements they need are available: bottles and milk, creams and nipples, music to soothe and put to sleep, the changing table for diapering, all of these are to hand, as is the Wi-Fi that will help them pass time until I get home. In short, if I make available the associated milieu that allows the caregiver to use the appropriate skills and do the job, the requested service can be provided. With adequate training and preparation, this person can easily move between families, on condition the apartments are properly equipped. Service can travel, just like the Golf. The caregiver’s skills in action, which are themselves framed, are available to me at a preagreed time slot. If I need to take my baby to be looked after by a student living in a sparely appointed studio apartment, I will need to make arrangements to supply the associated milieu, as well, one that would be easily mobilized at my house, but to which this young person may not have access. If I am attached to this person, having total faith in their qualities, I will have to take on this complex problem, which will lead me to furnish the missing elements myself. It is a bit as though the buyer of the Golf had to participate in setting up a garage near their house to be sure of being able to take advantage of its services or as though they were being asked to design the traffic rules and enforce them. This analysis applies to any prestation. Lisa Gitelman’s work shows that while Edison could record sound on tinfoil, the sound itself could be subject to a commercial transaction only if there were devices in homes to play it back.
The same applies to digital data: without an appropriate associated milieu to “read” them, they remain as mysterious as the silicon in which they are inscribed.

这一分析并不局限于所谓的物质对象。它可以扩展到一切服务。来我家照顾我小女儿的保育员，只有在所需的要素都可得时，才能做好自己的工作：奶瓶和牛奶、护肤霜和奶嘴、安抚和哄睡的音乐、换尿布用的台子，所有这些都触手可及，还有那能帮照护者打发时间直到我回家的 Wi-Fi。简言之，如果我提供关联环境，使保育员能够运用适当的技能完成工作，所请求的服务就可以得到提供。经过充分的培训与准备，这个人可以轻易地在不同家庭之间流动，条件是公寓得到妥善配备。服务可以旅行，就像那辆高尔夫一样。保育员行动中的技能——这些技能本身也是被框定的——在预先约定的时段内供我使用。如果我需要把宝宝送去由一个住在陈设简陋的单间公寓里的学生照看，我就需要作出安排，提供关联环境，一个在我家可以轻易调动、但这个年轻人可能无法获得的环境。如果我附着于这个人，完全信任其素质，我就必须承担这个复杂的问题，而这将导致我自己去添置那些缺失的要素。这有点像高尔夫车的买家不得不参与在自家附近建一个修车厂，以确保能够享用其服务；或者有点像有人要求他们去设计交通规则并加以执行。这一分析适用于任何给付。莉萨·吉特尔曼（Lisa Gitelman）的研究表明，爱迪生（Edison）虽然能在锡箔上记录声音，但声音本身只有在家庭中存在回放设备时，才能成为商业交易的对象。
数字数据也是如此：如果没有适当的关联环境来“读取”它们，它们就仍然像刻写它们的硅一样神秘。

Without its associated milieu, a good or service is nothing. And yet it can travel from one agent to another because it can be separated from its milieu. The car depends on the networks that fuel it and the administrations that regulate its uses, yet it remains distinct from them, which is what allows it to exist as a transferable good that can engage in the describable activities in which it participates. The principal task of the collective that conceives the good, individualizes it, and then transfers it to its user is to dissociate the good appropriately from its milieu while ensuring they remain complementary.
没有关联环境，物品或服务就什么也不是。然而，它能够从一个行动者旅行到另一个行动者，因为它可以与自己的环境分离。汽车依赖于为它提供燃料的网络和规范其使用的行政机构，但它仍然与这些网络和机构相区别，正是这一点使它能够作为一种可转移的物品而存在，能够参与它所介入的那些可描述的活动。构想物品、使之个体化、然后把它转移给使用者的集体，其主要任务就是恰当地把物品从其环境中分离出来，同时确保二者仍然互补。
All those who work to design and manufacture the vehicle must manage the feat of offering a good that can function
autonomously

, even as this functioning requires a milieu on which they generally cannot have much influence, at least in the short run. The technical architecture of my Golf can be read as a compromise between these contradictory requirements, autonomy and heteronomy, independence and dependence, with a tank that ensures fuel until the next refill, tires that adhere to the road enough, but not too much, so that movement and trips are possible, a steering wheel and a steering system that transfer control of the itinerary to me, and so on. The fuel tank, the tires, the steering wheel — these interfaces ensure the autonomy of the vehicle while cementing, as heteronomy requires, the relations it must maintain with its milieu so that this autonomy persists, is renewable, and is there for me to enjoy. When strikes lead to dry gas pumps or inaccessible highways, when the road infrastructure falls into disrepair, the automobile cannot conceal the fact that it is also a heteromobile.
所有参与设计和制造这辆车的人，都必须完成一项壮举：提供一种能够
自主

运作的物品，尽管这种运作需要一个他们通常无法施加多少影响的环境，至少在短期内如此。我的高尔夫的技术架构，可以被解读为这些相互矛盾的要求——自主与他律、独立与依赖——之间的妥协：油箱确保燃料直到下一次加油，轮胎与路面附着得足够紧，但又不至于过紧，从而使移动和旅行成为可能，方向盘和转向系统把行程的控制权交给我，如此等等。油箱、轮胎、方向盘——这些界面确保了车辆的自主性，同时又如他律所要求的那样，巩固了它为了维持这种自主性、使之可更新、并让我得以享用而必须与环境保持的关系。当罢工导致油泵干涸或高速公路无法通行，当道路基础设施失修，汽车就无法掩盖这样一个事实：它同时也是一辆他律汽车（heteromobile）。

To be successful, the disentanglement of the good that is called on to circulate must make it possible for an equilibrium to be reached, an always fragile and delicate equilibrium between autonomy and heteronomy. Only under this condition can the good be transferred and change hands. The problems to be solved in order to achieve this are always specific. They depend on the good or service.
要被召唤去流通的物品，其解缠必须能够促成一种平衡，一种在自主与他律之间始终脆弱而微妙的平衡。只有在这个条件下，物品才能被转移并易手。为此要解决的问题总是具体的。它们取决于物品或服务。
FRAMING REENTANGLEMENT: PASSIVA(C)TION
框定再纠缠：被动化

The career of a good begins with its judicious disentanglement, establishing a viable compromise between autonomy and heteronomy. This process is a required and obligatory passage point. For it to pursue its career, however, it must further insert itself into the life of its addressee.
物品的生涯始于它明智的解缠，即在自主与他律之间建立一种可行的妥协。这一过程是一个必需的、必经的关口。然而，物品要继续自己的生涯，就必须进一步插入其接收者的生活。
There is no lack of words for giving an account of this
reentanglement

. “Use,” “need,” “will to distinguish oneself,” “cupidity,” “desire” — these are just some of the notions frequently invoked for designating the mechanisms that draw goods and those they are destined for to one another. When nothing as yet indicates whether it will be a commodity, rather than a gift, one can also appeal to the obligation to accept and receive, a sense of friendship or of solidarity.
为说明这种
再纠缠
，并不缺少词语。“使用”“需要”“自我区隔的意志”“贪欲”“欲望”——这些只是人们经常援引的部分概念，用来指称把物品与其所指向的人彼此拉近的机制。当尚无任何东西表明它将是一件商品而不是一份礼物时，人们也可以诉诸接受与收受的义务，诉诸友谊感或团结感。

However relevant they may seem, these explanations have a serious drawback: they cut corners. Why not begin by sticking to what can be observed, rather than trying to identify motives or forces that are always hard to grasp? For a good, the reentanglement involves being engaged in courses of action that it has contributed to provoking or soliciting and that mingle its existence with that of its intended recipient. The courses of action may be multiple, and it would be unrealistic to establish an inventory of explanations, since one would have to list all the verbs in the English language. Any observation of one’s surroundings will show this diversity and its constant renewal. Collecting, moving around, communicating, caring for, cultivating oneself, playing, distinguishing oneself, feeding oneself, tending to one’s baby, mourning a relative, remembering loved ones: these are a few of the courses that goods arouse and into which they can reorient action, taking part and offering their contribution. The advantage of this open perspective is that it includes any of the preceding notions (need, desire, and so on) and is deliberately receptive to new descriptions. Moreover, it applies both to material goods and to services deemed immaterial, which can be described as particular courses of action. Finally, it is consistent with the most recent scholarly developments concerning the ways in which objects participate in collective life.

无论这些解释显得多么切题，它们都有一个严重的缺陷：它们抄了近路。为什么不从可以观察到的现象出发，而不是试图找出那些总是难以把握的动机或力量？对一个物品而言，再纠缠意味着被卷入一些行动过程——这些行动过程是它促发或招致的，并且把它的存在与其预期接收者的存在交织在一起。行动过程可能多种多样，而要建立一份解释的清单则是不现实的，因为那就得把英语里所有的动词都列出来。对周围环境的任何观察都会显示这种多样性及其不断的更新。收藏、四处走动、交流、照料、自我修养、游戏、区隔自身、进食、照看自己的孩子、哀悼亲人、怀念所爱之人：这些只是物品所唤起、并能将行动重新导向其中的若干过程，物品参与其中并作出自己的贡献。这一开放视角的优点是，它包含前面提到的任何概念（需要、欲望等等），并且有意对新描述保持开放。此外，它既适用于物质物品，也适用于被视为非物质的服务——后者可以被描述为特定的行动过程。最后，它与关于物如何参与集体生活的最新学术进展相一致。
Let us take the case of a photocopy machine. It invites certain courses of action that it solicits, promises, and allows and in which it participates.

Via its perfectly designed interfaces (screens displaying instructions or icons and technical affordances that invite users to undertake some kind of action, such as opening the lid, putting the document to copy at the right place, or refilling the paper compartment), it suggests certain operations and excludes others. It creates differences; it produces effects. While presenting itself as a simple instrument whose purpose is to produce copies, it
acts
and
makes act
according to certain modalities that characterize it as a copy machine.
让我们以一台复印机为例。它招致某些行动过程——它招揽、承诺并允许这些行动过程，同时参与其中。
通过其设计完美的界面（显示指令或图标的屏幕，以及邀请用户采取某种行动的技术可供性，例如打开盖子、把要复印的文件放在正确位置，或给纸盒补纸），它提示某些操作，排除另一些操作。它制造差异；它产生效果。尽管它把自己呈现为一件目的仅在于制作副本的简单工具，它却按照某些使它成为复印机的样式
行动
，并
促使他者行动

To describe this capacity that objects have to orient human action, Madeleine Akrich introduced the notion of the “script,” designating a set of actions suggested by material devices. As she put it, “Technical objects define a framework of action together with the actors and the space in which they are supposed to act.”

There are scripts in the simplest of objects around us. A speed bump indicates to the driver to slow down: “In a world where it can happen that children can come running out of school and cross the street without looking out for traffic.” The speed bump’s script is both technical (not slowing down means breaking axles) and moral (taking care of children).
为了描述物所具有的这种引导人类行动的能力，玛德琳·阿克里奇（Madeleine Akrich）引入了“脚本”（script）概念，指由物质装置所提示的一组行动。正如她所说：“技术物件界定了一个行动框架，连同行动者以及他们应当行动的空间。”
即使是我们周围最简单的物件中也有脚本。减速带向司机指示要放慢速度：“在一个孩子们可能从学校里跑出来、不看车就横穿马路的世界上。”减速带的脚本既是技术的（不减速就意味着撞断车轴），也是道德的（照料孩子）。

What is true of photocopiers or speed bumps is also true of any entity that is destined to be mobilized in any course of action, whether it is a car, a food processor, food, or medicine. A transgenic plant fights off undesirable parasites, secretes therapeutic substances, and resists weed killers: it has direct effects upon its environment — it acts. It also makes act both by inducing farmers to beware of its dissemination and by alleviating their workload; by pushing government to launch multidisciplinary research projects on public-health risks; by moving ecologists to undertake political protests; and by encouraging consumers to buy it by being regularly available and of predictable quality. The same goes for cyanobacteria, which naturally absorb carbon dioxide in the wild for their own development and which are reframed and reprogrammed to transform this greenhouse gas into fuel in a controlled and predictable manner, or for retroviruses, which naturally carry serious pathologies that are neutralized while preserving the viruses’ capacity to transfer molecules to tumors and destroy them.

复印机或减速带如此，任何注定要在某种行动过程中被调动的实体也是如此，无论它是一辆汽车、一台食品加工机、食品还是药品。一株转基因植物击退不受欢迎的寄生虫，分泌治疗性物质，抵抗除草剂：它对其环境产生直接影响——它在行动。它也使人行动：它促使农民提防它的扩散，同时减轻他们的劳动负担；它推动政府启动关于公共卫生风险的多学科研究项目；它促使生态学家发起政治抗议；它通过稳定供应和可预期的品质鼓励消费者购买它。蓝细菌也是如此：它们在野外为自身发育自然吸收二氧化碳，而被重新框定、重新编程，以便以可控且可预测的方式把这种温室气体转化为燃料；逆转录病毒同样如此：它们天然具有可导致严重疾病的致病性，这种致病性被消除，同时保留病毒把分子转移到肿瘤并将其摧毁的能力。
As these examples show, these different entities have been subjected to a formatting that channels their capacity to elicit courses of action and to participate in them efficiently.
正如这些例子所示，这些不同的实体都经受了一种格式化，这种格式化引导它们招致行动过程并有效地参与其中的能力。

Indeed, scripts do not describe all programs of possible actions a priori. They necessarily leave room for the unexpected, for improvisation, for novel courses of action, for diversions produced by the interactions in which objects are mobilized. Entities that have been taught through successive reformatting and reframing to engage in determined courses of action can at any moment reclaim the initiative, act in unexpected ways, and pull their intended recipients into uncontrollable adventures. As we will see further on, situations involving living beings are especially prone to this eventuality. For example, biological vectors used to transport molecules to specific targets can miss them, and chemical substances can create toxic side effects. Objects connected through communication networks are also more prone to slipping off script.

的确，脚本并不先验地描述一切可能行动的程序。它们必然为意外、即兴、新的行动过程以及由物被调动于其中的互动所产生的偏转留出空间。那些通过接连不断的重新格式化和重新框定而被教导去从事确定行动过程的实体，随时都可能收回主动权，以意想不到的方式行动，并把它们的预期接收者拖入无法控制的冒险。我们将在后文看到，涉及生命存在的情境尤其容易发生这种情况。例如，用于把分子运送到特定靶点的生物载体可能错过靶点，化学物质可能产生有毒的副作用。通过通信网络连接的物也更容易脱离脚本。

Reentanglement is part of the process that transforms a thing into a “usable” good that is able to take part in some course of action within the buyer’s world. To work, reentanglement must be framed, and the frame must be complex and well conceived. The balance is subtle — too much autonomy, and the good will becomes uncontrollably independent; too little autonomy will unduly restrict the scope of potential actions. As all drivers know, a car does not settle for being a passive tool for moving from point A to point B. It can suggest the races between rival gangs that delighted Hollywood studios in the sixties; it can transform a quiet family man into a madman ready to destroy everything in his path. And if connected to an autonomous driving system, it can reduce passengers to powerless robots.

再纠缠是把一个物转化为“可用的”物品的过程的一部分，这种物品能够参与买家世界中的某种行动过程。再纠缠要发挥作用，就必须被框定，而框架必须复杂且构思良好。平衡是微妙的——自主性太多，物品就会变得无法控制地独立；自主性太少，又会不适当地限制潜在行动的范围。正如所有司机都知道的，汽车不会满足于充当从 A 点到 B 点的被动工具。它可以诱发20世纪60年代令好莱坞制片厂欣喜若狂的敌对帮派之间的赛车；它可以把一个安静顾家的男人变成准备摧毁路上一切障碍的疯子。而如果连接到自动驾驶系统，它可以把乘客降格为无力的机器人。

Objects, goods, entities that have been ably disentangled to act autonomously, sometimes take such a pleasure in their autonomy that they overflow the frameworks designed for them, pushing action down unknown and unpredictable paths that may turn out to be undesirable.

The tension between autonomous action and independence applies to all goods that have been profiled to elicit people’s interest. Some are closer to one pole than the other, but all are subject to it to some degree. If the contradiction is not handled efficiently, it endangers their circulation and, of course, their (possible) aptitude for becoming commodities.
那些被巧妙地解缠、以便自主行动的物、物品、实体，有时如此享受自己的自主性，以至于溢出了为它们设计的框架，把行动推向未知而不可预测的路径，而这些路径最终可能变得不可欲。
自主行动与独立性之间的张力，适用于一切被塑造出轮廓以引发人们兴趣的物品。有些物品更接近这一极或那一极，但所有物品都在某种程度上受制于这种张力。如果这一矛盾没有得到有效处理，它就会危及物品的流通，当然也危及它们（可能具有的）成为商品的能力。

The set of specifications for entities destined to pass from hand to hand responds, therefore, to a triple requirement. First, the candidate thing must enjoy sufficient independence to be disentangled from its conceiver-producers and thus be able to circulate from place to place. “(Relative) autonomy” is the term for this property, which implies, among other things, that the thing not be condemned to immobility by too high a density. Second, the thing must be capable of acting and making act in such a way as to interest an acquirer. However — third requirement — its aptitude for entering into courses of action has to be framed: the behavior of the thing has to be sufficiently predictable and controllable to avoid unexpected and unmanageable disturbances. Autonomy, capacity to contribute to courses of action, and predictability are the properties that, in variable modes, must be found in any good that aspires to change hands. Obtaining these properties usually requires operations to shape and transform, solving problems that depend on the things involved and are most acute when these are living beings or connected objects. For example, to anticipate and avoid risky and dangerous situations, a driverless car should allow passengers to monitor and master their environment and, if necessary, make decisions they deem appropriate.
I would like to suggest the name
passiva(c)-tion

for the strange process that leads an entity to be capable of living its own life, to be active, to act and make act, but not too much, and always in a specific manner within preestablished frameworks.

因此，为那些注定要易手的实体所制定的一套规格，回应着三重的要求。第一，候选之物必须享有足够的独立性，以便从其构想者—生产者那里解缠出来，从而能够从一个地方流通到另一个地方。“（相对的）自主性”是对这一属性的称谓；它尤其意味着，物不会因密度过高而注定无法移动。第二，物必须能够行动并促使他者行动，其方式足以引起获取者的兴趣。然而——第三个要求——它进入行动过程的能力必须被框定：物的行为必须足够可预测、可控制，以避免意外且难以处理的干扰。自主性、对行动过程作出贡献的能力以及可预测性，是任何渴望易手的物品都必须以可变方式具备的属性。获得这些属性通常需要加以塑造和转化的操作，需要解决取决于所涉之物的种种问题，而当所涉之物是生命存在或联网物品时，这些问题最为尖锐。例如，为了预见并避免有风险的危险情境，无人驾驶汽车应当允许乘客监控并掌控自己的环境，并在必要时作出他们认为适当的决定。
我想为这个奇特的过程提议一个名称：
被动化
（passiva(c)tion）——它使一个实体能够过自己的生活，能够主动，能够行动并促使他者行动，但又不能过度，并且始终以特定方式在预先建立的框架内进行。

Passiva(c)tion, considered as a continuous process, leads the good to enter the life of its addressee, to penetrate the intimate spaces of that life. The simple fact of participating in a course of action that cannot be reduced to any other course of action, not even a similar one, is a matter of what Simondon called “individuation.” The good does not suddenly barge into the addressee’s life. Both evolve together — we are gradually tangled up with it. This is why I will refer to
singularization

. The driver, such and such a driver, such and such a car, and their associated milieus are in permanent symbiosis and develop a unique story. The skeptics who zealously denounce consumerist society may mock this driver, and yet this driver, who moons over his sparkling new customized Golf, a few hundred thousand apparently identical copies of which are in daily circulation on the road and that he nevertheless considers unique, is a far better philosopher than all those who hold him in contempt.
被动化被视为一个连续的过程，它引导物品进入其接收者的生活，深入那种生活的私密空间。参与某种行动过程这一简单事实——这种行动过程不能被化约为任何其他行动过程，甚至不能被化约为一种相似的行动过程——关乎西蒙东所谓的“个体化”（individuation）。物品不会突然闯入接收者的生活。二者一起演化——我们逐渐与它纠缠在一起。这就是我要谈到
独一化
的原因。司机，某一个司机，某一辆车，以及它们的关联环境，处于永久的共生之中，发展出一段独一无二的故事。那些热切谴责消费社会的怀疑者也许会嘲笑这位司机，然而，这位司机痴迷地凝视着自己闪亮的新定制高尔夫——路上每天有几十万辆看似一模一样的复制品在流通，他却仍然认为自己的车独一无二——比起所有鄙视他的人，他是远为出色的哲学家。
NONMARKET-ORIENTED PASSIVA(C)TION: KEEPING WHILE GIVING
非市场取向的被动化：给予中保留

Consider a successful passiva(c)tion. The good has been profiled to change hands. It is capable of participating in courses of action and thus escapes the fatal destiny of the numerous innovations that interest no one. It is neither too active nor too unpredictable; it acts and makes act in an orderly fashion, following the programs that have been imagined for it, without too much deviation. Yet having been made transferable, the good is not quite ready to be transformed into a commodity. It remains for it to be detached from the entity that puts it into circulation.
设想一次成功的被动化（passiva(c)tion）。物品已被塑形，以便转手。它能够参与各种行动过程，从而逃脱了众多无人问津的创新所注定的命运。它既不过分活跃，也不至于过于不可预测；它行动，并促使他者井然有序地行动，遵循为它设想的种种纲领，没有太大的偏离。然而，物品虽已变得可转移，却尚未完全具备转化为商品的条件。它还须从那个将其投入流通的实体中脱离出来。

To account for the detachment process that allows for property rights to be switched, I need to return to the work in economic anthropology. Ever since the seminal work of Mauss and Malinowski and their reevaluation by Sahlins, one of the major concerns of economic anthropology has been the relationship between gift and market transactions. The answer given depends on the type of question posed. Some have been interested in analyzing the different forms of economies and associated social relations when each of these types of good circulates, while others have been focused on the issue of domination. Yet others have probed the deep meaning of these categories. My objective is not to take part in those debates, let alone to take sides. As I have written previously here, what interests me in this multifarious and often contradictory literature is the analytical tools it proposes in order to describe the modalities of disentanglement and entanglement or to express the movement of detachment and reattachment in words. It happens that authors such as Thomas, Weiner, and Godelier developed concepts that turn out to be valuable for my own project, even if they are engaged in different theoretical projects. The simplest strategy to reveal the mechanisms of detachment is to consider the goods that remain attached to a person or lineage. These goods are characterized, as we say, by a high density that condemns them to immobility. Over the course of time, numerous strong attachments have been woven such that the goods have become part of the people who hold them. In the Western world, inheritance refers to this type of configuration. In popular understanding, what can be inherited (
un héritage
) is what an individual owns, what he has. In French law, the old idea of a
bien inné
(innate good), a good that “cannot be separated from the person’s very existence,”

gives a pretty good idea of this form of relationship. Attached goods constitute extended bodies for their owners, variable over time, and yet coherent in such a way as to ensure at least temporary indivisibility. They participate in the constitution of the owner’s identity.

要说明使财产权得以转换的脱离过程，我需要回到经济人类学的研究。自莫斯（Mauss）与马林诺夫斯基（Malinowski）的开创性著作、以及萨林斯（Sahlins）对他们的重新评价以来，经济人类学的主要关切之一，一直是礼物与市场交易之间的关系。给出的答案取决于所提问题的类型。有些人感兴趣的是，当各类物品各自流通时，分析不同的经济形式及与之相关的社会关系；另一些人则聚焦于支配问题。还有一些人探究这些范畴的深层含义。我的目标不是加入这些争论，更不是选边站队。正如我此前在本书中所写，在这庞杂而常常自相矛盾的文献中，令我感兴趣的是它所提出的分析工具，用以描述解缠与纠缠的诸种模态，或用词语表达脱离与重新附着的过程。托马斯（Thomas）、韦纳（Weiner）和戈德利耶（Godelier）等作者所发展的概念，恰好对我的研究计划颇有价值，尽管他们从事的是不同的理论计划。揭示脱离机制最简便的策略，是考察那些始终附着于某个人或某个世系的物品。这类物品的特征，如我们所说，在于一种高密度，这使它们注定无法移动。随着时间推移，无数强烈的附着被编织起来，以致物品已成为持有者的一部分。在西方世界，继承指的就是这种配置。在通俗理解中，可被继承的东西（
un héritage
，遗产）就是个人所拥有、所占有的东西。在法国法中，“天赋财产”（
bien inné
）这一古老观念——即一种“不能与个人的存在本身相分离”的财产
——相当好地表达了这种关系形式。附着性物品构成了其所有者的延展身体，随时间而变化，却又连贯一致，从而至少确保暂时不可分割。它们参与所有者身份的构成。

Such an attachment can be obtained and sanctioned by a thousand different devices. Weiner, who studies Oceanic societies and revisits Malinowski’s work, refers to a jumble of rites, origin myths, genealogies, and their connections to the gods. In Western societies, the law plays a central role, sustained by many material and narrative devices that make explicit, guarantee, and certify possession and the associations that constitute possession. Such goods can be described as inalienable. They cannot be ceded or detached; one cannot
dispossess
oneself of them because that would be to make one a stranger to oneself. Maurice Godelier, prolonging and enriching Weiner’s analyses, adds that this is how the sphere of the sacred is constituted.
这种附着可以通过千百种不同的装置获得并得到认可。韦纳研究大洋洲社会，并重新审视马林诺夫斯基的著作，她提到一堆混杂的仪式、起源神话、谱系及其与诸神的联系。在西方社会，法律扮演核心角色，并得到许多物质性与叙事性装置的支持；这些装置明确、保障并认证占有以及构成占有的种种关联。这类物品可被描述为不可让渡的。它们不能被割让或脱离；人不能
剥夺
自己对它们的占有，因为那将使自己成为自己的陌生人。莫里斯·戈德利耶（Maurice Godelier）延续并丰富了韦纳的分析，补充说神圣领域正是由此构成的。

Weiner goes further. She makes a genuine discovery by showing that there exist certain goods that, while inalienable, can nevertheless be alienated. Translation: they can be kept, even as they are given to another. They pass into B’s hands while remaining in A’s possession (keeping while giving).
韦纳走得更远。她有一项真正的发现：存在某些物品，虽然不可让渡，却仍然可以被让渡。译成白话：它们可以在被给予他人的同时被保留。它们进入B的手中，却仍留在A的占有之中（给予中保留）。

Godelier illustrates this strange and paradoxical practice through the example of the Baruya, where women are circulated through marriage. As he tells it, the practice is based on the direct exchange of two women between two men and two lineages, the sister of each becoming the other’s wife. Each family remains obliged to the other throughout its lifetime; both share the yield of their fields and their salt, which serves as money. They mutually invite each other; they clear land together for new gardens. The obligation persists despite the fact that B has given his own sister in marriage to A, whose sister he married, because the woman that was given was not really separated or completely disjoined from the one who did the giving. In the Baruya community, women have a double status: they are both entities that circulate and family members who continue to belong to the lineage from which they issue.

戈德利耶以巴鲁亚人（Baruya）为例，说明这种奇特而悖谬的实践：在那里，女性通过婚姻而流通。据他所述，这一实践基于两名男子、两个世系之间两名女性的直接交换：每一方的姐妹成为另一方的妻子。每个家庭终其一生都对另一个家庭负有义务；双方共享田地的收成和充当货币的盐。他们相互邀请；一起清理土地，开辟新的园圃。尽管B已将自己的姐妹嫁给A、又娶了A的姐妹，义务依然持续，因为被给予的女人并未真正与给予者分离，也没有完全从给予者那里脱离。在巴鲁亚共同体中，女性具有双重身份：她们既是流通的实体，又是仍然属于其出身世系的家庭成员。
Let us summarize: in keeping while giving,
a) the good changes hands while continuing to be attached to Person A who puts it into circulation;
b) the good does not cease to belong to A while being in B’s possession, and then in C’s, and so on;
c) the good carries something of A with it — let us say that A is present in the good and acts in it as a restoring force.
让我们总结一下：在给予中保留这一实践中，
a) 物品转手，却继续附着于将其投入流通的A；
b) 物品在B、随后在C等人的占有之中，却并未停止归属于A；
c) 物品随身携带着A的某种东西——不妨说，A临在于物品之中，并在其中作为一股恢复力起作用。

All those who have at some point taken an interest in property rights will inevitably recognize these practices as illustrations, not explicit, but direct, of the bundle-of-rights theory. In this way of conceiving property, different rights are attached to a thing. One of the most accomplished formulations of this theory is given by Elinor Ostrom. According to her, a property right includes rights of access, withdrawal, management, exclusion, and alienation. One can thus distinguish between owners (for instance, communal) who do not have alienation rights and owners who have all the rights and can therefore enter into commercial transactions.

The list of rights can be extended and detailed, but the essential thing, for my purposes here, is the simple separation between, on the one hand, the right of use and, on the other hand, the right to alienate, to separate, to detach, to no longer be present in the thing. The very existence of “keeping while giving” practices proves this separation is possible and shows its relevance in understanding why inalienable goods can be put into circulation and pass from hand to hand. Once reformulated in the terms of Western legal theory (A keeps the right of alienation and transfers use rights to B), this practice of dismembering property seems not only conceivable, but is actually not unusual, as the following illustrations show.

所有曾经关注过财产权的人，都会不由自主地把这些实践认作“权利束”（bundle of rights）理论的例证——不是明确的例证，而是直接的例证。按照这种构想财产的方式，不同的权利附着于一物之上。埃莉诺·奥斯特罗姆（Elinor Ostrom）给出了这一理论最完备的表述之一。在她看来，一项财产权包括进入、提取、管理、排除和让渡的权利。由此可以区分两类所有者：不拥有让渡权的所有者（例如共同体所有者），以及拥有全部权利、因而能够进行商业交易的所有者。

权利清单可以延长、细化，但就我此处的目的而言，要点在于一种简单的分离：一方面是使用权，另一方面是让渡权——让渡、分离、脱离、不再临在于物之中的权利。“给予中保留”实践的存在本身就证明这种分离是可能的，并显示它对于理解不可让渡的物品为何能被投入流通、在手中传递具有相关性。一旦用西方法学理论的语言重新表述（A保留让渡权，把使用权转让给B），这种分割财产的做法似乎不仅可设想，而且实际上并不罕见，正如下面的例子所示。

If I keep the bare property rights to an apartment for myself, contrary to what is usually done for fiscal reasons, while giving a usufruct to a friend, I would say that the thing (the apartment) remains in my possession while being useable by a third party.
如果我为自己保留一套公寓的虚有权（bare property rights），与通常出于税务考虑的做法相反，同时把用益权（usufruct）给予一位朋友，那么我会说，物（公寓）仍在我的占有之中，却可以由第三方使用。

Scientific activity provides another illustration. The law that states the proportional relation between force and acceleration remains attached to Newton, while all are free to use it. When I apply it to a new situation, I have the usufruct, but I know full well that it remains, as grammar indicates, Newton’s law, a law that is firmly attached to its discoverer. A law that has not been discovered and that therefore cannot be attributed to anyone is like an apartment that no one can identify and localize and that therefore no one can use. The law without “its” Newton disappears; Newton without “his” law is no longer Newton.
科学活动提供了另一个例证。陈述力与加速度之间比例关系的那条定律，仍然附着于牛顿，而所有人都可以自由使用它。当我把它应用于一种新情境时，我拥有用益权，但我完全清楚，正如语法所表明的，它仍然是牛顿的定律，一条牢牢附着于其发现者的定律。一条尚未被发现、因而无法归属于任何人的定律，就像一套无人能够辨认和定位、因而无人能够使用的公寓。没有“它的”牛顿的定律会消失；没有“他的”定律的牛顿也不再是牛顿。

The famous Brennus Shield that the French Rugby Federation bestows each year for a one-year period on the captain of the winning team of the French championship provides another example. The club keeps it for a year and then returns it to the federation, to which it continues to belong, which then puts it back in circulation the following year. The shield, which the rugbymen nickname
la planche
(the board), remains in federation’s possession while having toured France several times since its creation in 1892.
法国橄榄球联合会（French Rugby Federation）每年授予法国锦标赛冠军队队长的著名“布伦努斯盾”（Brennus Shield），为期一年，提供了另一个例子。俱乐部保管它一年，然后归还给联合会——它始终属于联合会——联合会次年再把它投入流通。这面盾牌被橄榄球员戏称为
la planche
（木板），它始终归联合会所有，而自1892年创设以来已多次巡游法国。

Disentangling (to allow circulation) without detaching (to maintain possession) requires a great deal of know-how, ingeniousness, and skill. In so-called modern societies, the law, as we have just seen, obviously plays an essential and irreplaceable role, both by offering an analytic framework (for the possible dismembering of property rights) and by providing for and imposing constraints (sanctions). And yet on its own, it cannot ensure that all the conditions for “keeping while giving” be satisfied. Without proofs and material markers to support it in the event of challenges or litigation, the law is insufficient.
解缠（以允许流通）而不脱离（以维持占有），需要大量诀窍、巧思与技艺。在所谓现代社会中，法律正如我们刚刚看到的，显然扮演着本质而不可替代的角色：它既提供分析框架（用于可能发生的财产权分割），又规定并施加约束（制裁）。然而，仅凭自身，它无法确保“给予中保留”的所有条件都得到满足。一旦遇到质疑或诉讼，若没有证据和物质标记的支持，法律便力有不逮。
Mauss’s
The Gift
is a convenient place to start to introduce this point. Picking up on
hau

, a key notion of Maori law that can be understood, according to him, as the spirit or soul of the person who gives, Mauss insists on the presence of the giver in the thing; this presence is not superficial, not simply inscribed in the thing like a signature or a reference. The
hau
is the giver in the given thing; it marks that the thing is still in the giver’s possession and that it cannot be definitively detached from him.
莫斯的《礼物》（
The Gift
）是引入这一点的一个便利起点。他接续毛利法中的一个关键概念
hau
（豪），按照他的理解，
hau
可被理解为给予者的精神或灵魂；莫斯坚持给予者在物中的临在。这种临在并不浮于表面，也不是像签名或引证那样简单地铭刻在物上。
hau
就是被给予之物中的给予者；它标志着物仍在给予者的占有之中，不能最终与他脱离。
Mauss’s interpretation has given rise to many critical commentaries that, except for Lévi-Strauss’s, do not question the idea that something of the giver remains in the given thing.
But how does this presence manifest itself? As Godelier quite rightly observes, however one makes sense of the notion of
hau
, it would be a mistake to consider that it is a pure phenomenon of belief and imagination. This is not so. For the mechanism of disentanglement without detachment to function properly, A
really
must be present in the good. This requires specific devices, necessarily material, that have been constantly invented, tested, transformed, and transmitted over the course of time.
莫斯的解释引出了许多批评性评论；除了列维-斯特劳斯（Lévi-Strauss）的评论之外，这些评论都没有质疑“给予者的某种东西留在被给予之物中”这一观念。
但这种临在如何显现？正如戈德利耶十分正确地指出的，无论人们如何理解
hau
这一概念，若认为它纯粹是信仰与想象的现象，那就错了。事实并非如此。要使“解缠而不脱离”的机制正常运作，A
确实
必须临在于物品之中。这需要特定的、必然是物质性的装置；这些装置在时间进程中被不断发明、检验、改造和传承。
Viviana Zelizer has studied these devices extensively. She observes that the most common strategy for maintaining the attachment of a thing that circulates is
earmarking

. Originally, this notion referred to the marks made by farmers on the ears of their herd animals to mark ownership. By means of this little mutilation, the (relatively) indelible presence of the farmer is conserved in the animal’s flesh. The animal, however, is not hampered by this intervention, since the scarification does not prevent movement or even a possible change of hands. However, anyone who crosses a marked cow’s path knows that they meet the animal’s owner who really is there, in the animal, not distant, but present, actual.
维维安娜·泽利泽（Viviana Zelizer）对这些装置做过广泛研究。她观察到，维持流通之物附着关系的最常见策略是标记化（
earmarking
）。这一说法原指农民在牲畜耳朵上做标记，以标明所有权。通过这一小小的残伤，农民那种（相对）不可磨灭的临在被保存在动物的血肉之中。然而，动物并不因此受到妨碍，因为这种划痕既不阻止它行动，甚至也不妨碍它可能转手。不过，任何与一头带标记的母牛相遇的人都知道，他们遇到的是这头动物的主人；主人确实就在那里，在动物之中，不是远隔的，而是临在的、实际的。

A banknote, designed to pass anonymously from one hand to another and to be easily detached from the last person to hold it, can be transformed into a gift that remains attached to the giver. The most standard practice, which at some point became a national sport in Italy, is to write a few words on the bill that will remind the receiver of the donor’s name and affection. Any bill, at any time, can be diverted with a slight transformation — a little indelible ink will mark, materially modify, the thing and qualify it as a potential gift. Similarly, a first name engraved on a piece of jewelry can make certain that a donor is present at his loved one’s side. Earmarking, says Zelizer, can be generalized to cover a set of practices that modify a thing to create a reminder of its attachment. Many different transformations can be imagined. The banknote, rather than being the medium for love notes, might be slipped into an envelope with a kind word. A coin, on which it is difficult to write anything, can be personalized through the choice of metal used. When a grandparent gives it to their grandchild, they transform the silver (the metal) into a mark that is all the more powerful if it is accompanied by an admonishment such as “Put it in the piggybank I gave you for Christmas.”

一张钞票本被设计为匿名地从一只手传到另一只手，并易于与最后持有它的人脱离，却可以被转化为一件仍附着于给予者的礼物。最标准的做法——它一度在意大利成为一项全民运动——是在钞票上写下几个字，让收受者想起赠予者的名字与情意。任何一张钞票，在任何时候，都可以经由轻微的改造而被挪作他用：一点不可磨灭的墨水会标记这件物，从物质上改变它，并把它界定为一件潜在的礼物。同样，在一件首饰上刻下一个名字，可以确保赠予者临在于其所爱之人的身旁。泽利泽说，标记化可以一般化，用以涵盖一组实践：它们改造一物，以制造对其附着关系的提醒。可以设想许多不同的改造。钞票不必充当情话的载体，也可以被塞进一个写着温言暖语的信封。一枚难以在上面写字的硬币，可以通过所用金属的选择而个性化。当祖父母把它送给孙辈时，他们就把白银（金属）转化为一种标记；若配上一句叮嘱，如“把它放进我圣诞节送你的存钱罐里”，这标记就更为有力。

Marking by engraving, marking by making sure the thing is accompanied by a few scribbled words or a well-crafted speech, marking by depositing something of oneself in the thing — numerous earmarking strategies can be imagined to ensure the effective presence in the thing of the person who put it into circulation and to whom it continues to belong, even in their absence.

Nonetheless, however intense the marking, this binding presence is never established once and for all. The envelope can be torn up, the bill with the scrawl or coin from the grandfather can be put into circulation, the piece of jewelry can be pawned. To keep possession, the force of law (or custom) is, as we have seen, often necessary. Truth be told, it is in fact the combination of both that ensures the attachment endures and is robust. The anecdote that follows gives an indication of how this works.
用雕刻来标记，用几句潦草的字句或一篇精心措辞的讲话来陪伴此物以作标记，把自己的某种东西寄托于物中以作标记——可以设想众多标记化策略，以确保将物投入流通、并始终拥有该物的人在物中的有效临在，即便此人不在场。
然而，无论标记多么强烈，这种具有约束力的临在从来不是一劳永逸地确立的。信封可能被撕毁，带有潦草字迹的钞票或祖父给的硬币可能被投入流通，首饰可能被典当。如我们所见，要维持占有，法律（或习俗）的力量往往必不可少。说实话，实际上是两者的结合才确保附着得以持久而稳固。下面这则轶事可以说明这是如何运作的。

Zelizer tells the story of a rich widower who gave his mistress and her twin sister the equivalent of a million dollars, in cash or in kind, over more than seven years. Every ten days, Mrs. Conley came to receive money, or an object, that the millionaire’s secretary would hand over to her personally. The tax authorities found out about this and had the millionaire condemned for tax evasion because they considered that the sums transferred in this manner were not gifts, but genuine payments for sexual services. Put in prison, the sisters appealed after the millionaire’s death. And they won! The judges considered that the money and things that had changed hands were presents and that it was not a matter of paying for sexual services. The proof? The love notes that the millionaire slipped into the envelopes full of banknotes; the notes materially marked his presence. Irrefutable.

泽利泽讲述了这样一个故事：一位富有的鳏夫在七年多的时间里，以现金或实物的形式，给了他的情妇及其孪生姐妹相当于一百万美元的财物。每隔十天，康利夫人（Mrs. Conley）就来领取钱款或物品，由百万富翁的秘书亲手交给她。税务部门得知此事，并使这位百万富翁因逃税而被判有罪，因为他们认为以此种方式转移的款项并非礼物，而是为性服务支付的真实报酬。两姐妹入狱后，在百万富翁去世后提起上诉。她们赢了！法官认为，转手的金钱与物品是礼物，并非为性服务付费。证据？是百万富翁塞进装满钞票的信封里的情话字条；这些字条从物质上标记了他的临在。无可辩驳。
MARKET-ORIENTED PASSIVA(C)TION: DISENTANGLEMENT WITH DETACHMENT
面向市场的被动化：伴随脱离的解缠
The difference between
nonmarket-oriented
and
market-oriented

passiva(c)tion is a tenuous one. The former maintains attachment, whereas the latter ensures detachment. In one case, A retains possession; in the other, possession is transferred to B. Under these circumstances, in order to move from one regime to the other, would it be enough to attach property rights to the thing (for instance, the right to alienate, as it is defined in the bundles-of-rights theory), to attribute these rights to A, and then to give A the capacity for ceding them to B?
非市场取向
的被动化与
面向市场
的被动化之间，差别十分细微。前者维持附着，后者确保脱离。在一种情形中，A保留占有；在另一种情形中，占有转移给B。在此情况下，要从一种体制转向另一种体制，是否只需把财产权（例如权利束理论所界定的让渡权）附着于物，把这些权利归属于A，然后赋予A将其让渡给B的能力？

Granted, such arrangements are necessary, and we will examine the problems they pose in a coming section. Without them, no commercial transfer can be concluded. However, they are not sufficient in themselves to ensure such transfers. The law, which alone cannot provide an answer to the question of attachment, cannot solve the problem of detachment alone, either. Just as attachment does, detachment requires that a good be transformed so that it may be torn away from its prior owner. Thomas provides this intuition when he makes the case that “the alienation of a thing [object, person, or element of a person] is its dissociation from producers, former users, or prior context”

and insists on the material operations that produce this dissociation. The reality of the work involved in this detaching is never so clear as when it is a matter of making detachable a thing that has been previously attached to the person who puts it into circulation.
诚然，这类安排是必要的，我们将在后面的一节中考察它们带来的问题。没有它们，任何商业转让都无法完成。然而，仅凭它们本身，并不足以确保这类转让。法律单凭自身无法回答附着问题，也无法独自解决脱离问题。与附着一样，脱离也要求物品被改造，以便能从其先前的所有者那里被撕扯下来。托马斯提出了这一直觉：他主张，“一物［对象、人或人的某个要素］的让渡，就是它同生产者、先前使用者或先前情境的分离”，
并坚持强调产生这种分离的物质操作。当事情涉及把一件先前附着于流通发起者的物变得可以脱离时，这种脱离工作之现实性最为清楚。
Consider an autographed letter written and signed by a famous person — Pasquale Paoli, for instance.

Suppose he gave it to a friend or an admirer. Paoli is, beyond any possible doubt, present in the letter: there is not a single upstroke or downstroke that does not recall the pen and the hand that held it. That presence is, of course, essential, but it does not ensure Paoli’s presence in the sense defined above. As the American judges made clear when they ruled on Mrs. Conley and her sister’s appeal, something more is needed — a mark, in that case, a mark of affection, saying that this is indeed something that carries with it the person who put it into circulation. A few words traced out on a sheet of vellum paper to go with the letter, if it is sent by mail, or a little speech full of feeling, if it was hand delivered by Paoli.

These very simple devices requalify the letter in such a way that it prolongs Paoli’s person; it is part of him. And the words that surround the letter, whether written or spoken, add new associations, entangling it further, manifesting and explaining the attachment: “I give it to you for it to attest to my affection; I will be at your side through it, you will think of me.”
设想一封由某位名人——比如帕斯夸莱·保利（Pasquale Paoli）——书写并签名的亲笔信。

假设他把它送给一位朋友或仰慕者。保利无可置疑地临在于这封信中：没有一笔上行笔画或下行笔画不令人想起那支笔和握笔的手。这种临在当然是本质性的，但它并不确保上文所界定意义上的保利的临在。正如美国法官在审理康利夫人及其姐妹上诉时明确指出的，还需要某种更多的东西——一个标记；在那个案子里，是一个情意标记，表明这确实是携带着流通发起者本人的东西。若是邮寄，就在一张犊皮纸上写下几句话随信附上；若是由保利亲手递交，就讲一段充满感情的话。
这些极其简单的装置重新界定了这封信的品质，使它延长了保利的人格；它成为他的一部分。而围绕这封信的话语，无论是书面的还是口头的，都增添了新的关联，使它进一步被纠缠，并显现和解释这种附着：“我把它给你，让它见证我的情意；我将通过它陪伴在你身旁，你会想起我。”

Experience shows that even duly marked, the given thing can find another life and be transformed into a commodity. The mechanism is quite simple. It requires either purely and simply erasing (or disqualifying) the material proof, textual or oral, that attests to the connections between the thing and the person who put it into circulation or transforming the attachments into mere references and traces. The first strategy, when it is possible, is the most immediate and inexpensive. All that is required is to get rid of the wrapping paper and the kind little note, as happens when people put things up for sale on the internet the day after Christmas. Stripping the thing does not require much effort or audacity, especially if the donor is not the sort to check what happened to his present. “What in the world did you do with the gaming console? I don’t see it anymore!” The second strategy is subtler and more general. The hand-written letter is no longer a thing that puts its addressee in the presence of Paoli in person. It is transformed into a letter that, just like the accompanying note, is endowed with a new quality — namely, that of having been written by the very hand of a great person. The largely indelible associations (the upstrokes and the downstrokes) combine with other marks initially destined to ensure the presence of the person (the note accompanying the letter) in such a way as to redefine the thing, enrich it with new characteristics, and transform its qualification.

The presence is transformed into a reference materialized in traces that can be authenticated; the traces add a new property to the thing, rather than attesting that it is (still) possessed by its emitter. This is the result of the work of
demarking

经验表明，即便经过适当标记，被给予之物也能获得另一种生命，转化为商品。其机制相当简单。它要求要么干脆抹去（或取消其效力）那些证明物与流通发起者之间关联的物质证据——文本的或口头的证据——要么把附着转化为单纯的指涉与痕迹。第一种策略在可行时最为直接、成本最低。只需丢掉包装纸和那张善意的小纸条，就像人们在圣诞节次日把东西挂到网上出售时那样。剥除物的外衣并不需要多少力气或胆量，尤其当赠予者不是那种会查问自己礼物下落的人时。“你到底把那台游戏机弄哪儿去了？我怎么看不见它了！”第二种策略更微妙，也更为普遍。那封手写信不再是一件使收信人置身于保利本人面前的东西。它被转化为一封信——就像随附的字条一样——被赋予一种新的品质，即它出自一位伟人之手。那些大体上不可磨灭的关联（上行笔画与下行笔画）与最初旨在确保此人临在的其他标记（随信附上的字条）结合起来，从而重新界定此物，以新的特征充实它，并改变它的品质界定。
临在被转化为一种指涉，它物质化于可被鉴定的痕迹之中；这些痕迹为物增添了一种新属性，而不是证明它（仍）为其发出者所占有。这就是“去标记”（
demarking
）工作的结果。

Demarking, whereby marks are transformed into traces and references, requires the construction of a narrative that introduces a plot connecting different events in the life of the thing — in this case, the letter. Simultaneously, the thing, which will no doubt have been appraised, is transformed. Here, the letter is now escorted by documents, catalogs, certificates, graphologist reports, anecdotes about Paoli’s life. The set of these textual, iconic, and audiovisual elements associated with the letter tell, narrate, and attest to the series of events inscribed in it, extending it and forming its new substance. The stories woven together on this occasion are very different from the discourses that accompanied the gift. Rather than attaching it to Paoli, they supplement the thing, adding new qualities to it. Remember Mrs. Conley and her judges — what would they have decided had she taken it into her mind to compose brochures and catalogs, including an index for the sweet notes, recounting the curriculum vitae of the jewels received and showing bundles of bills with their serial numbers? This very simple example allows us to grasp the relevance of the notions suggested by anthropologists. To explain how a thing is profiled to become a commodity or to switch over to a noncommercial regime, one needs to consider the series of associations, the successive operations of entanglement and disentanglement, the practices of earmarking and demarking. Either the thing says and repeats that it is one with the donor and that it remains attached to the donor even if it changes hands, or it circulates in such a way as to liberate itself from the person who puts it into circulation without their presence being preserved except as a traceable reference: it says and repeats that it is no longer in the possession of the one who has parted with it, even, or especially, if it preserves the mention of them having been there. In this second scenario, it has acquired a form of independence. Appropriately defined, property rights can effectively be attached to it.

去标记，即把标记转化为痕迹与指涉，要求建构一种叙事，引入一个情节，把物——在此情形中是那封信——生命中的不同事件连接起来。与此同时，这件无疑会被估价的物也被改造。在这里，这封信如今由文件、目录、证书、笔迹鉴定报告以及关于保利生平的轶事伴随左右。与这封信相关的这些文本性、图像性和视听性要素的整体，讲述、叙述并证明铭刻于信中的一系列事件，延长了它，并构成它新的实质。在此场合编织起来的故事，与伴随赠礼的话语大不相同。它们并不把信附着于保利，而是补充此物，为其增添新的品质。想想康利夫人和那些法官——假如她心血来潮，编出小册子和目录，为那些情话字条编一份索引，叙述所收珠宝的履历，并展示一捆捆标有序列号的钞票，他们会作何判决？这个极其简单的例子使我们能够把握人类学家所提示的那些概念的相关性。要解释一物如何被塑形以成为商品，或如何转入非商业体制，就需要考察一连串的关联、接连进行的纠缠与解缠操作，以及标记化与去标记的实践。要么此物言说并反复言说：它与赠予者合为一体，即便转手也仍附着于赠予者；要么它如此流通，以致从流通发起者那里解放出来，而此人的临在只作为可追溯的指涉被保留：它言说并反复言说，它不再为那个与之分离的人所占有，即便——或者尤其——它保留着此人曾经在场的记载。在第二种情形中，它获得了一种独立形式。只要得到适当界定，财产权便能有效地附着于它。

The problem that must be solved in cases where marked goods must be unmarked is not an exceptional one: the general rule, if there is one, is that objects always keep the imprint, in one form or another, of those through whose hands they pass.

At the heart of detachment, there is, then, the tension between marking, which proves presence, and the transformation of marks into references, which enriches the process of qualifying goods. This tension increases with the growing role of accumulated biographical references in the career of things that are engaged in market circuits and notably with the strategy of commercial brands (
marques
) that synthesize these references.

It culminates with the demand for traceability. A traceable good is one whose career and biography are established, attested, and made public. Each episode of its life, associating it to a particular agent or event, adds a new quality to it, facilitating the evaluation (examined in Chapter 3). A Camembert is a Camembert
from
Normandy, made with unpasteurized milk,

Traceability, which must avoid the trap of marking, is extremely strategic: it not only establishes the qualities of the good — it also guarantees a well-managed passiva(c)tion insofar as the history of a being is taken as some guarantee of future behavior.
在必须去除带标记物品之标记的情形中，所要解决的问题并非例外：如果存在通则，那就是，物品总会以某种形式保留经手者的印记。
于是，在脱离的核心处，存在着一种张力：一边是证明临在的标记，另一边是把标记转化为指涉，而后者丰富了物品品质界定的过程。随着累积的传记性指涉在进入市场流通之物的生涯中作用日益增长，尤其是随着商业品牌（
marques
）策略——这些品牌综合了上述指涉——的发展，这种张力也随之加剧。
它在可追溯性要求中达到顶点。可追溯的物品，其生涯与传记得到确立、证明并公之于众。它生命中的每个插曲，把它与某个特定行动者或事件联系起来，都为它增添一种新品质，便利了评估（第3章将考察）。一块卡芒贝尔（Camembert）奶酪，是诺曼底
出产
、以生奶制作、依传统工艺用勺舀入模（
moulé à la louche
）的卡芒贝尔；一位大学教授可能曾在著名诺贝尔奖得主、物理学家理查德·费曼（Richard Feynman）指导下完成博士工作。可追溯性必须避开标记的陷阱，它具有极强的策略性：它不仅确立物品的品质，还保障了管理良好的被动化，因为一个存在者的历史被视为其未来行为的某种保证。

The material work that ensures the transition from nonmarket-oriented passiva(c)tion to market-oriented(and vice versa) is gradual and progressive; this explains why certain goods can have a hybrid status. Fair trade offers a good illustration. A package of coffee carries two stories. One story ensures the producer is present to the consumer with a message, amplified by ads and packaging, that says, “It is for you that he worked; show you are grateful”; the other story makes each connection into an event whose trace is preserved, all of which are thought to enrich the coffee’s qualities.

Observation shows how many ways there are of fine-tuning these two stories: some goods give a very analytic and fact-based account of their biographies — for instance, through technical data sheets or in a description of the ingredients inscribed on the packaging, while others, on the contrary, make their life into an inexhaustible source of continuously changing qualities, as in the case of works of art when they are put up for auction. Well-drafted love letters are open to both interpretations and both destinies: Do not forget me! Be happy to have known me!
确保从非市场取向的被动化过渡到面向市场的被动化（以及反向过渡）的物质工作，是渐进且逐步的；这就解释了为什么某些物品可以具有混合身份。公平贸易提供了一个很好的例证。一包咖啡承载着两个故事。一个故事确保生产者以其讯息临在于消费者面前，这讯息经由广告与包装放大，说道：“他是为你而劳作的；表现出你的感激吧”；另一个故事则把每一重关联变成其痕迹得以保存的事件，人们认为所有这些都会丰富咖啡的品质。
观察表明，调校这两个故事的方式何其之多：有些物品对其传记给出极具分析性、以事实为依据的叙述——例如通过技术数据表，或通过写在包装上的成分说明；另一些则相反，把自己的生命变成不断变化的品质之不竭源泉，就像艺术品被送上拍卖会时的情形。写得好的情书对两种解释、两种命运都敞开：“不要忘记我！”“为认识过我而高兴吧！”

It is not easy to carry out the operations, often violent, that ensure the success of market-oriented passiva(c)tion. Seen from the point of view of those who work to establish market transactions, these operations, when they abort, can be experienced as failures when it comes to the confrontation between two opposing regimes: the one that strives to detach and the one that maintains attachment. A striking illustration of such a situation is given by Fred Myers’s work on land transactions between Aboriginals and Westerners. When a newly arrived European acquires a piece of land in Australia, paying for it and registering the property transfer, the Aboriginals from whom the European thinks he is buying the land consider they are selling hot air. Indeed, despite the money he has received, he keeps that land, which is associated with a cosmological order about which the contract says nothing, but which imposes such weighty connections to the land that any complete and permanent detachment is impossible. Not only is the density of the land such that disentangling the connections so that it might become exchangeable is impossible within a normal contractual framework; the transaction was in any case bound to fail, since the contract did not provide a full inventory of associations.

执行那些往往带有暴力的操作、以确保面向市场的被动化成功，并不容易。从那些致力于确立市场交易的人的观点看，当这些操作流产时，在两套对立体制——一套力求脱离，另一套维持附着——的对峙中，它们可能被体验为失败。弗雷德·迈尔斯（Fred Myers）关于原住民与西方人之间土地交易的研究，为这种情境提供了一个引人注目的例证。当一位新到澳大利亚的欧洲人购得一块土地、付款并办理产权转移登记时，那位欧洲人自认为从其手中买地的原住民却认为自己卖的是空气。实际上，尽管收了钱，原住民仍然保有那片土地；这片土地与一种宇宙论秩序相关联，契约对此只字未提，但这种秩序强加了如此沉重的土地联系，以致任何彻底而永久的脱离都不可能。不仅土地的密度使得在正常契约框架内无法解缠这些关联、使之变得可交换；而且这笔交易无论如何注定失败，因为契约没有提供一份完整的关联清单。

If only those Europeans had more clearly understood that in some market transactions, you can keep the thing while selling it in the same way as gifts keep the presence of the donor. The difference is that the good to which the contract refers is not the same for both parties. A land with ancestors attached is not a land with detached ancestors. The dissonance is neither cognitive nor symbolic. It is really the outcome of the thing itself, considered as the outcome of a nexus of associations. Thinking that the deal is incomplete or that the Aboriginal will finally become reasonable is just denying the existence of two radically incompatible cosmologies. Had Westerners chosen not to dispossess natives by whatever means, they could have imagined law devices allowing compromises acceptable to both sides. Actually, such devices could exist, as proved by the bundle-of-rights theory.

那些欧洲人要能更清楚地理解就好了：在某些市场交易中，你可以像礼物保留赠予者临在那样，在出售一物的同时保留它。差别在于，契约所指的物品对双方而言并不相同。附着着祖先的土地，不是祖先已脱离的土地。这种失调既不是认知的，也不是象征的。它确实是物本身的结果——物被视为一组关联网络的结果。认为交易不完整，或认为原住民最终会变得通情达理，不过是否认两种根本不相容的宇宙论的存在。假如西方人选择不以任何手段剥夺原住民，他们本可以设想出法律装置，达成双方都能接受的妥协。事实上，这类装置可以存在，权利束理论即证明了这一点。

I have chosen this case because the confrontation between two cosmologies is well articulated and extreme. But as we will see later in this chapter, similarly extreme situations are commonplace within societies that share common views on the nature of markets.
我选择这个案例，是因为两种宇宙论之间的对峙表述得清楚而极端。但正如我们将在本章后文看到的，在那些对市场本质持有共同看法的社会内部，同样极端的情境也司空见惯。
THE PROBLEM OF PROPERTY RIGHTS
财产权问题

Detaching the good for its possible reattachment elsewhere paves the way for the transfer of property rights against payment, without which there is no market transaction. In order to circulate, to pass from hand to hand, a good must be disentangled from its associated milieu while maintaining the relations that allow it to function. This double requirement, a source of tensions and contradictions, makes detachment tricky. It is notably difficult to identify Agent A, the entity that gets property rights and who will therefore be entitled to transfer them to Agent B.
把物品脱离出来，以便它可能在别处再附着，这为以支付为对价转让财产权铺平了道路；没有这种转让，就没有市场交易。物品要流通、要易手，就必须从其关联环境中解缠出来，同时保持那些使它得以运作的关系。这一双重要求是张力与矛盾的来源，使脱离变得棘手。尤其困难的是指认行动者 A——那个获得财产权、因而有权将财产权转让给行动者 B 的实体。

These sorts of difficulties have an obvious origin. The associated milieus have to be carefully and conveniently designed and manufactured to make feasible the disentanglement of the good and their unbroken functioning. A Golf drives on a network of highways governed by traffic laws, an iPod a child has spent all his money on can’t stream songs without iTunes, a babysitter arrives into a prepared environment that allows the caregiver to provide care. Providing the milieu requires work, inspiration, and a great deal of perspiration.
