）通过一种逆转录病毒类型的病毒载体被插入患者的细胞。该载体使基因得以穿透细胞并插入基因组；缺失的蛋白质遂在患儿体内产生。这一步完成之后，经过校正的细胞——它们是负责免疫防御的要素（T淋巴细胞）的来源——被重新注入患者体内。阿兰·菲舍尔（Alain Fischer）为这项任务选择的第一个载体，是一种看起来完全符合条件的逆转录病毒。在试验中，事实却并非如此。尽管它在多数病例中有效，可靠地履行了载体和简单运输机制的职责，但它却在某些婴儿身上诱发了白血病，因为它擅自将自己插入到某个促癌基因附近。结果表明，这种病毒大体上能完成自己的工作，但如同所有生命体一样，它有时会做出被告知之事以外的事情，触发不可接受的行动。

To regain control of the virus’s passiva(c)tion, the scientific community decided to research and modify the vector so as to control it more efficiently and make it safer. The size of the new institute leading the fight against genetic diseases gives some sense of the order of magnitude of the work and investments that were required to manage to discipline these recalcitrant entities. It includes more than four hundred and fifty researchers who follow cohorts of patients (more than eighteen thousand) from childhood through adulthood, combining cutting-edge biological research and clinical procedures. In order to align the treatments and manage them so they can in fine be subject to commercial transactions, the vectors have to be selected and pass(act)ivated in such a way as to limit the range of actions possible for them to those of faithful, predictable conveyors that ensure that their package, the gene drug, arrives at the predicted site and that, once arrived, it does its job properly. This logistical requirement applies everywhere. It has been at the heart of medicine for a while, but it becomes ever more pressing and hard to satisfy when treatments, as is increasingly the case, rest on the alignment and the activation of long chains of living beings who have to continue to live their lives while also remaining within a set and predictable framework without untimely overflowing. Pass(act)ivating the retrovirus and the gene-drug requires, as is the case of any entity whose vocation is to become a commodity, their careful disentanglement. For instance, in certain therapeutic strategies, the chosen retrovirus is one that in its “wild” state is responsible for AIDS: its functions, therefore, had to be meticulously deactivated. These genetic or cellular therapies reveal the operations of disentanglement and reentanglement in a pure form, highlighting the scale and scope of the problems that must be solved in order for the two operations to be successful.

为了重新控制病毒的被动化，科学界决定研究和改造载体，以便更有效地控制它，并使其更加安全。领导抗击遗传病斗争的新研究所的规模，多少能让人感受到，要驯服这些顽抗的实体，需要何等量级的工作与投资。该研究所包括四百五十多名研究人员，他们追踪患者队列（超过一万八千人）从童年到成年的情况，将前沿生物学研究与临床程序结合起来。为了使治疗协调一致，并加以管理，使其最终（in fine）能够成为商业交易的对象，必须对载体进行选择和被动化—激活，把其可能行动的范围限制在忠实、可预测的传送者角色之内，确保其所运载的包裹——基因药物——抵达预定地点，并在抵达后正确发挥作用。这一后勤要求无处不在。它一段时间以来一直是医学的核心，而当治疗——情况越来越如此——依赖于对长长生命链的协调与激活时，这一要求就变得愈发紧迫、愈发难以满足，因为这些生命体必须继续过自己的生活，同时又留在既定、可预测的框架之内，不发生不合时宜的溢出。逆转录病毒与基因药物的被动化—激活，如同任何注定成为商品的实体一样，需要对其加以细致的解缠。例如，在某些治疗策略中，所选的逆转录病毒在其“野生”状态下正是导致艾滋病的病毒：因此，必须一丝不苟地使其功能失活。这些基因疗法或细胞疗法以纯粹的形式揭示了解缠与再纠缠的操作，凸显了为使这两项操作成功而必须解决的问题的规模与范围。

The example of genetic therapies is particularly striking, but what is called biomedicine is rife with such situations and configurations. The therapies’ targets are less and less local and discrete entities such as cells, or genes that are separate and (relatively) independent of one another and more and more complex biological processes, putting into play a multitude of entities and interactions (they are described as cascading reactions) whose malfunction is responsible for the pathology in question. The effects of the interventions imagined to deal with these are very difficult to anticipate. Adjusting them requires incessant back-and-forth between the lab and the hospital bed. It depends on the patient’s personality and leads to singularizing constantly evolving treatments, treatments that never really move out of the experimental phase. The idea of ontological uncertainty that I evoked earlier applies perfectly to these treatments, just as it applies to transgenic plants or certain chemical molecules. Passiva(c)tion aims to make a profit from all of them while trying to manage them through a framework.

基因疗法的例子尤其引人注目，但所谓的生物医学中充斥着这类情境与配置。疗法的靶标越来越少是局部的、离散的实体，例如细胞，或彼此分离、（相对）独立的基因，而越来越多是复杂的生物过程，调动大量实体与相互作用（它们被称为级联反应），正是这些过程的失常导致了相关病变。为应对这些过程而设想的干预措施，其效果极难预料。调整这些干预需要在实验室与病床之间不断往返。它取决于患者的个体特性，并导致对不断演化的治疗进行独一化，这些治疗从未真正走出实验阶段。我先前提到的本体论不确定性这一观念，完全适用于这些治疗，正如它适用于转基因植物或某些化学分子。被动化旨在从所有这些当中获利，同时试图通过框架来管理它们。

This example taken from medicine, more specifically, biomedicine, resonates with service activities. As Jean Gadrey showed, services can be described as systems that mobilize simultaneously and in varying proportions nonhuman entities (generally called technical entities, but that can be, as in medicine, nonhuman living beings such as retroviruses) and human beings in order to accomplish certain courses of action that, if the service proves of good quality, are successfully led to term.

The rental car offer allows me to go from Paris to Marseille to take care of my elderly ailing mother and to visit the Mucem museum; the offer of IT consulting allows a company to set up a costaccounting system to track how its costs evolve; the offer of music streaming allows an adolescent to listen to his favorite singer and to revel in the pleasure of hearing his inimitable voice yet again. From this perspective, a service is not different from traditional material goods: if a user decides to buy a computer, a frozen pizza, or a subscription to Spotify, it is because each of these goods authorizes him to realize certain actions he prizes (surfing the internet, quelling his hunger, or letting himself stream his favorite songs). The only difference is that the good generally boils down to a material assemblage, whereas the service involves a complex arrangement combining human beings and technical entities. Services and the actions that they offer, promise, allow, and enable are harder to stabilize and control, notably because that requires making sure that the humans (or the nonhuman living beings in the case of biomedicine) involved do not take (too much) initiative.

Reducing the part of humans and/or Taylorizing their activities are the two most common strategies. These strategies cannot, however, solve all the passiva(c)tion problems for services because pushed to their extreme, they threaten quality and effi -ciency. Through gradual adjustments, service design must find a compromise between too much and too little discipline so as to tap living beings’ capacities for improvising and adapting while protecting themselves from derailing, the acts of resistance or even sabotage, of which they are also capable.

Making an inventory of the different strategies deployed is one research aim for those interested in market agencements. It would no doubt show the growing importance of computer devices that enable controls without hampering initiative too much or that are designed to guide robots and their algorithms within frameworks.
这个取自医学——更具体地说，生物医学——的例子，与服务业活动产生共鸣。正如让·加德雷（Jean Gadrey）所表明的，服务可以被描述为这样的系统：它同时并按照不同比例调动非人实体（通常称为技术实体，但也可以像医学中那样，是非人生命体，例如逆转录病毒）与人，以完成某些行动方案；如果服务质量良好，这些行动方案便会被成功地完成。

租车服务使我能够从巴黎前往马赛，照顾年迈多病的母亲，并参观马赛的欧洲与地中海文明博物馆（Mucem）；IT咨询服务使一家公司能够建立成本核算系统，以追踪其成本如何变化；音乐流媒体服务使一名青少年能够聆听他最喜欢的歌手，并再次陶醉于听到那无可比拟的嗓音的愉悦之中。从这个角度看，服务与传统物质物品并无不同：如果用户决定购买一台电脑、一份冷冻披萨或一项Spotify订阅，那是因为这些物品中的每一个都授权他去实现某些他所珍视的行动（上网、充饥，或任由自己流式播放最喜爱的歌曲）。唯一的区别在于，物品通常归结为一种物质装配，而服务则涉及一种结合人与技术实体的复杂安排。服务以及它所提供、承诺、允许和促成的行动，更难被稳定和控制，尤其因为这需要确保所涉的人（或在生物医学情形中的非人生命体）不（过多地）采取主动。
减少人的参与份额和/或对其活动实行泰勒制，是两种最常见的策略。然而，这些策略无法解决服务的所有被动化问题，因为一旦推到极端，它们就会威胁质量与效率。服务设计必须通过逐步调整，在纪律过多与过少之间找到一种妥协，以便利用生命体即兴与适应的能力，同时保护自己免遭脱轨——免遭它们同样能够实施的反抗行为甚至破坏行为。
对已部署的不同策略进行盘点，是那些对市场装配感兴趣的人的一项研究目标。这无疑将显示计算机装置日益增长的重要性：它们能够在不怎么妨碍主动性的情况下实现控制，或者被设计用来在框架内引导机器人及其算法。

The scope and the nature of ontological uncertainties surrounding goods involved in commercial transactions are at the heart of concerns and problems that their framing provokes. Yet as we have already examined, we must never forget that other sources of concerns and questions connected to the attribution and transfer of property rights graft onto these uncertainties and complicate the picture. A passiva(c)ted and detached good does not automatically become a commodity. To claim commercial status, the passiva(c)tion must also be compatible with the attribution of property rights and their transfer.
围绕商业交易中所涉物品的本体论不确定性的范围与性质，处于其框定所引发的关切与问题的核心。然而，正如我们已经考察过的，我们绝不能忘记，与财产权的归属和转让相关的其他关切来源与问题，会嫁接在这些不确定性之上，使图景变得更加复杂。一个被被动化并脱离的物品并不会自动成为商品。要主张商业地位，被动化还必须与财产权的归属及其转让相容。
SOME FINAL REMARKS ON OVERCOMING TRIALS OF STRENGTH IN PASSIVA(C)TION
关于克服被动化中力量考验的几点结语

The transformation of any sort of entity into a passiva(c)ted good is a long process that must fulfill a precise and demanding set of specifications. This process has not yet been given all the attention it deserves, no doubt because the structural model of the interface market so present in the implicit representations of commercial activities tends to suggest that it lies outside markets in the strict sense and that it interferes only very marginally with the way markets work.
把任何一类实体转化为被动化的物品，都是一个漫长的过程，必须满足一整套精确而严苛的规格要求。至今，这一过程尚未得到它理应得到的全部关注；这无疑是因为，界面市场的结构模型如此普遍地存在于人们对商业活动的隐含表象之中，以致它往往暗示：这一过程位于严格意义上的市场之外，只以极其边缘的方式干扰市场的运作方式。
This chapter has taken a different point of view. All of these activities are at the heart of
market agencements

because the very possibility of commercial transactions depends on them. They take the form of a sequence of operations that constitute a series of mandatory steps. That is why it is relevant to talk of framing (
cadrage
) and to add that its success is never guaranteed.
本章采取的则是另一种观点。所有这些活动都处于
市场装配
的核心，因为商业交易的可能性本身正取决于它们。它们表现为一连串操作，构成一系列必经的步骤。正因如此，谈论框定（
cadrage
），并补充说它的成功从无保证，才是切题的。
A first way of showing the importance of a phenomenon is to give it a name. I suggested we speak of market
passiva(c)tion

to refer to the framing without which no market could exist. Having recognized its importance, the ambition of this chapter was to begin exploring this process by proposing first elements of analysis.
要表明一个现象的重要性，第一种办法就是给它一个名称。我曾建议用“市场
被动化
”来指称那种没有它便不可能有任何市场的框定。在认识到它的重要性之后，本章的雄心便是通过提出一些初步的分析要素，开始探索这一过程。
In anthropology, some studies have drawn attention to the mechanisms that by affecting and transforming the goods themselves prepare them to become commodities. From their perspective, the notion of
disentanglement

already appeared central. Any entity whatsoever is caught up in a web of sociotechnical associations, relations that constitute it, some of which must be undone for it to be put into circulation. If it is not to be condemned to endless wanderings, the entity must then reassociate with the one who takes hold of it. However, this double movement, without which a thing would be condemned to immobility, can take very different forms, depending on whether the anticipated outcome is a gift or a commercial transaction. In the first case, the presence of the one who puts it into circulation (and thus becomes its donor) is maintained, and the thing continues to be a part of him in some way, whereas in the second, the thing is rendered independent of the one who becomes its seller. I use the word “detachment” to refer to this particular mode of disentangling.
在人类学中，一些研究已经让人注意到这样一些机制：它们通过作用于物品本身并使之转化，把物品准备成商品。从这些研究的视角看，
解缠

概念已经显得居于核心。任何实体都卷入一张社会技术关联之网，即构成它的种种关系；其中有些关系必须被拆解，它才能被投入流通。而为了不注定无休止地漂泊，该实体随后必须与抓住它的那个人重新建立关联。然而，这一双重运动——没有它，一个物就会被判为静止不动——可以采取极为不同的形式，取决于所预期的结果是赠礼还是商业交易。在第一种情形中，把物投入流通的那个人（因而成为其赠与人）的在场得以保持，物在某种意义上继续是他的一部分；而在第二种情形中，物则被弄得独立于那个成为其出售者的人。我用“脱离”（detachment）一词来指称这种特殊的解缠方式。

The possible reassociation of the good to an agent (its buyer) depends on its capacity to act and to make act, which enables it to be involved in courses of action undertaken by the buyer. However, this
reentanglement

will be successful only if the good’s capacity to act is both real and framed. If this were not the case, the good would rapidly involve a number of agents not party to the (bilateral) transaction in unpredictable and uncontrolled ways; the latter could rapidly be led to contest the content or terms of the transaction. We can agree to call this particular mode of reassociating goods “reattachment”; we can, therefore, speak of processes of detachment and reattachment.
物品与某一行动者（其购买者）重新关联的可能性，取决于它行动并促使他者行动的能力，这种能力使它能够被卷入购买者所从事的行动过程。然而，只有当物品的行动能力既是真实的又是被框定的，这种
再纠缠
才会成功。倘若不是这样，物品就会以不可预测、不受控制的方式，迅速把若干并非该（双边）交易当事人的行动者卷入其中；后者可能很快被引向质疑交易的内容或条件。我们可以同意把这种重新关联物品的特殊方式称为“再附着”（reattachment）；因此，也就可以谈论脱离与再附着的过程。

For the transformation to be successfully completed, the set of specifications that frame the transformation of things into commodities requires that a last step be taken: the permutation of property rights in return for monetary compensation. We saw that to identify those rights, to attribute them (first to the developers/producers), and then to transfer them, one has to be able to distinguish between the actions concerning the good and those aiming at its associated milieu. If the detachment is done according to this requirement — that is to say, if the interfaces are developed in such a way as to ensure the good’s controlled dissociation from its milieu while maintaining relations between the two, then the good’s passiva(c)tion is successful, and it can henceforth be sold and bought: in this case, one can speak of
market-oriented passiva(c)tion

要使这一转化圆满完成，那套框定物之转化为商品的规格要求必须走出最后一步：以货币补偿为对价置换财产权。我们已经看到，要指认这些权利、把它们（首先）归于开发者/生产者、然后再加以转让，人们必须能够区分涉及物品的行动与旨在作用于其关联环境的行动。如果脱离按照这一要求来完成——也就是说，如果界面的开发方式能够确保物品与其环境受控地分离，同时维持二者之间的关系——那么物品的被动化就是成功的，它从此可以被出售和购买：在此情形中，人们可以谈论
面向市场的被动化

The mere description of the sequence of operations necessary for market-oriented passiva(c)tion shows that this metamorphosis is far from straightforward. Its success can remain uncertain because of its complexity and the often massive and coordinated investments it requires. Not least among the difficulties is implementing the series of transformations and translations that make goods transferable, autonomous, predictable, detachable, followed by the possible support of property rights. Each case is singular, raises particular difficulties, and calls for specific solutions. Amazon’s data, lands, money, and financial products, labor forces, the wild plant become certified variety — these do not go through the same transformations and do not require the same investments. Not only are the imagined solutions unique — they are also provisional, fragile, and always contestable. Each good offers solutions or resists in its own way.

仅仅描述面向市场的被动化所必需的操作序列，就足以表明：这种蜕变远非直截了当。由于其复杂性，也由于它往往要求大规模且相互协调的投入，其成功可能始终是不确定的。其中尤为突出的困难之一，是实施一系列转化与转译，使物品变得可转移、自主、可预测、可脱离，随后还可能获得财产权的支撑。每一个案都是独一的，会带来特殊的困难，并要求特定的解决办法。亚马逊（Amazon）的数据、土地、货币与金融产品、劳动力、由野生植物变成的认证品种——这些并不经历相同的转化，也不要求相同的投入。所设想的解决办法不仅是独一无二的，而且是暂时的、脆弱的、始终可以争议的。每一件物品都以自己的方式提供解决办法，或进行抵抗。

I have compiled a table to indicate how certain categories of goods, over the course of the long story of their commercial domestication, revealed their relative aptitudes for transforming into commodities. I would ask the reader to indulge me by considering the following attempt at a schematic summary of what has been said in the preceding pages. This presentation, to be discussed and enriched, is simply provided to give some idea what such a table might look like. Bear in mind that the qualification of the different dispositions, as they appear in the table, can be read as a summary of the series of trials of strength each entity has overcome over its history.
我编制了一张表，用以显示某些类别的物品在其商业驯化的漫长故事中，如何显露出各自转化为商品的相对禀赋。我想请读者包涵，随我一起看看下面这一尝试：对前文所述内容作一图式化的概括。这一呈现尚待讨论与充实，提供它只是为了让人对这样一张表可能是什么样子有所了解。请记住，表中对不同性向（dispositions）所作的品质界定，可以读作对每一实体在其历史中已经克服的一系列力量考验的概括。

As with all of the framings we will review in the following chapters, market-oriented passiva(c)tion provokes resistances, alternative initiatives that act as so many forces pushing for the reorganization and reconfiguration of activities. We could easily give an inventory of these. I will come back to this in Chapter 7. For the moment, we can simply evoke as illustrations the innumerable conflicts, protests, and struggles provoked in the last century by the overflowings of the chemical industry.

Or in the same register, consider the objections to instituting a market for carbon emissions quotas, which, according to some, endorses the right to liberate (to disentangle) carbon buried in the earth’s crust and then to detach it from those who liberated it, when it should have been left in the earth with no property rights attached to it at all. Or think of the many ongoing struggles generated by the passiva(c)tion of human labor. As for disentangling living beings other than humans, this has caused increasing worries, resulting in the recent evolution of the law and new constraints implied for the market-oriented passiva(c)tion of animals or plants. The distinction between domestic animals (such as cows, dogs, and cats), liminal animals (such as storks, squirrels, or voles), and wild animals (such as wolves or boars) might lead to the recognition of different rights, depending on how the animals participate in collective life and in particular on the relationships of dependence in which they hold us and we hold them.

Similarly, new conceptions of plant life invoke scientific authorities that highlight the complex networks and subtle interactions that plants develop among each other and that disentanglement practices imperil.

To touch one of these beings is to intervene in the web of connections it depends on and to activate the resistances they carry. These concerns amplify, as we have seen, with the conception of genetically modified plants and the break with their milieu that it provokes.
In all these cases, including the booming activities associated with datafication,
the question raised is the one so well identified by Thomas, namely, that of the possibility and viability, of disentanglement with detachment.
与我们在随后各章将要考察的一切框定一样，面向市场的被动化会引发抵抗，即一些替代性的倡议，它们作为一股股力量，推动活动的重组与重新配置。我们本可以轻易地为这些抵抗开列一份清单。我将在第7章回到这一点。目前，我们只需举例提及上个世纪化学工业的溢出所引发的无数冲突、抗议与斗争。

或者在同一层面上，想想对设立碳排放配额市场的反对意见：在某些人看来，这种市场认可了这样一项权利——把埋藏在地壳中的碳释放出来（解缠出来），然后再把它与那些释放它的人脱离；而本来应当让碳留在地里，根本不附带任何财产权。或者想想人类劳动的被动化所引发的许多仍在进行的斗争。至于对人类之外的生命体进行解缠，这已引起越来越多的忧虑，导致法律近来的演变，并给动物或植物的面向市场的被动化带来了新的约束。家养动物（如牛、狗、猫）、阈限动物（如鹳、松鼠或田鼠）与野生动物（如狼或野猪）之间的区分，可能导致承认不同的权利，这取决于这些动物如何参与集体生活，尤其取决于它们以何种依赖关系牵系我们、我们又以何种依赖关系牵系它们。
同样，关于植物生命的新观念援引科学权威，这些权威强调植物彼此之间发展出的复杂网络与微妙互动，而解缠实践正危及这些网络与互动。
触碰这些存在者中的任何一个，就是介入它所依赖的连接之网，并激活它们所承载的抵抗。正如我们所见，随着转基因植物的构想以及由此引发的与环境的断裂，这些关切进一步放大。
在所有这些情形中，包括与数据化相关的蓬勃活动，
所提出的问题正是托马斯（Thomas）如此清楚地指认的那个问题，即伴随脱离的解缠之可能性与可行性问题。

However, no doubt the most striking are the escalating worries connected to the increasing financialization of the economy — that is to say, the commodification of money. Money is accused of corrupting and depersonalizing human relationships. That is no doubt why there are more and more initiatives that aim to frame and fragment the instrumental functions of money so that it becomes neither too liquid nor too viscous. In the face of all the overflowings of money that is too liquid, real monetary insurgency is developing, to pick up on the suggestive expression through which Frédéric Lordon and André Orléan characterize the repeated insurrection of private money against state money.

The deindexation that affects exchange rates and makes exchanges more difficult, recourse to foreign currencies so as to escape national monetary constraints, freeing inflation, and debt restructuring are some of the strategies for effecting a greater separation between the means of payment and store-of-value functions. The attempts (often aborted!) to standardize financial products in order to introduce viscosity in speculative operations and the generalization of participatory financing platforms specializing in credits and loans should also be mentioned. These devices (would) contribute to multiplying the currencies whose functions and modes of circulation are or would be tightly regulated. The struggles have never been as intense and violent between specialized and universal currencies as in today’s turbulent world.

然而，无疑最引人注目的，是与经济日益金融化——也就是说，货币的商品化——相关联的不断升级的忧虑。货币被指控败坏人际关系并使之去人格化。无疑正因如此，越来越多的倡议试图框定并分割货币的工具性功能，使它既不太流动，也不过于黏滞。面对过于流动的货币所造成的一切溢出，一场真正的货币叛乱正在发展——这里借用了弗雷德里克·洛尔东（Frédéric Lordon）与安德烈·奥尔莱安（André Orléan）用以刻画私人货币反复起来反抗国家货币的那个富有启发性的说法。

影响汇率并使交换更加困难的去指数化、为逃避国家货币约束而求助于外币、放任通货膨胀、债务重组，这些都是一些策略，用以在支付手段功能与价值贮藏功能之间实现更大的分离。还应提到那些为使金融产品标准化、以便在投机操作中引入黏滞性的尝试（往往流产！），以及专门从事信贷与贷款的参与式融资平台的普及。这些装置有助于（或可能有助于）使货币成倍增加，而这些货币的功能与流通方式实际受到或可能受到严格管制。在专用货币与通用货币之间，斗争从未像在当今动荡的世界中这样激烈和暴烈。

In conversations about those famous fictitious commodities, as in the realm of health care and the environment, where the controversies concerning commodification are particularly lively and intense, what is at stake is the crucial question of disentangling and of detachment. The answers do not preexist; they are not known ahead of time; they are generally multiple and contradictory and are decided after experiments and trials that test the solidity of connections and the will to undo or consolidate, them.
在关于那些著名的虚构商品的讨论中，正如在医疗与环境领域——那里围绕商品化的争论尤为活跃和激烈——真正攸关的，是解缠与脱离这一关键问题。答案并不预先存在；它们不为人事先所知；它们通常是多元而相互矛盾的，是在检验联系之牢固程度、以及拆解或巩固这些联系之意愿的实验与考验之后才被决定的。

The clash at the heart of market agencements between forces mobilized to ensure the success of disentanglement and detachment and the forces opposed to that appears most clearly in the ecological controversies that, through the references they make to nature, provide repeated occasions to redefine the place of the market. For example, costly, complex investigations are undertaken in order to decide on reparations or compensation; over the course of investigations that become a sort of coming-of-age adventure, the actors discover how and why they were affected by the catastrophe that struck them. Let us follow Marion Fourcade in her remarkable comparative analysis of French and American oil spills.
At the end of their collective investigation following the spill of the
Amoco Cadiz

off the coasts of Brittany, residents reached a nonnegotiable conclusion. It is because they are attached to a nature, which is itself attached to them and from which they do not wish to detach, that the damage affects the whole of their world, a complex world in which every element depends on every other and in which it would be vain to attempt to separate the population of the shoreline from the nature that makes them live and that they make live. In the United States, the disentangling is easier because, as Fourcade shows concerning the spill from the
Exxon Valdez

, the disentangling is largely already realized and institutionalized — nature is separate from society and kept at a distance from the public; as a result, detachment becomes possible, even if it requires considerable effort. For the Americans, financial compensation can be legitimate reparation for the damage, whereas for the Bretons, the only imaginable reparation would be one that took as its task to weave back together the dense web of relations that the oil spill distended, those between their community and nature. Fourcade makes perfectly clear that on the French side, the collective investigation shows that the Bretons are profoundly attached to their environment and that no compensation can wash away the outrage. On the American side, with the help of economic science, people come to terms with the idea that the damage can be erased by monetary compensation, since the interests and the fate of the human communities can be detached from those of nature. Granted, in this example there is no
good
involved, only
harm

. However, when the question as to their transformation into commodities comes around, the same goes for goods and harms: what opposes their change of status is the refusal to advance in the project of detaching and reattaching. The Bretons refuse to link the oil spill to a list of identifiable effects that concern only them and for which they would ask for monetary compensation. What the investigation concluded was that the oil spill affects them
and

their associated milieu; it is not possible to distinguish between the two. One can, of course, invoke ethical or moral convictions or worldviews or ideologies to explain whether actors move into market action or refuse to do so. Doing so, however, leads to ignoring or minimizing the importance of the work in relation to which successfully refusing is only a result. If goods are processes, and not platforms, the work involved aims at manufacturing associations; its stakes are detachment and reattachment.

市场装配核心处的冲突——一方是为确保解缠与脱离成功而动员起来的力量，另一方是反对此事的力量——最清楚地显现在生态争论之中；这些争论通过对自然的援引，一再提供重新界定市场位置的时机。例如，人们展开代价高昂、错综复杂的调查，以便就赔偿或补偿作出决定；在那些变成某种成年礼式历险的调查过程中，行动者发现他们是如何、又为何受到了降临于他们的灾难的影响。让我们跟随玛丽昂·富尔卡德（Marion Fourcade），看她对法国与美国漏油事件的出色比较分析。
在阿摩科·卡迪兹号（
Amoco Cadiz

）于布列塔尼（Brittany）沿海失事之后，居民们经过集体调查，得出了一个不容讨价还价的结论。正是因为他们附着于一种自然，而这种自然本身也附着于他们，并且他们不愿与之脱离，损害才影响了他们的整个世界——一个复杂的、其中每一要素都依赖于其他一切要素的世界，在这个世界里，试图把沿岸居民与那使他们得以生活、而他们也使之得以生活的自然分开，将是徒劳的。在美国，解缠要容易一些，因为正如富尔卡德就埃克森·瓦尔迪兹号（
Exxon Valdez

）漏油事件所表明的，解缠在很大程度上已经实现并制度化了——自然与社会彼此分离，并与公众保持距离；因此，脱离成为可能，尽管它需要付出相当大的努力。对美国人来说，金钱补偿可以是对损害的正当赔偿；而对布列塔尼人来说，唯一可以想象的赔偿，将是以重新编织那张被漏油撑裂的稠密关系网为己任的赔偿，那张网存在于他们的共同体与自然之间。富尔卡德十分清楚地表明，在法国一方，集体调查显示，布列塔尼人深深地附着于他们的环境，任何补偿都无法洗刷这一侵害。在美国一方，借助经济科学，人们接受了这样一种观念：损害可以通过金钱补偿来抹去，因为人类共同体的利益与命运可以与自然的利益与命运相脱离。诚然，在这个例子中涉及的并非
物品
，而只是
损害
。然而，当问题转到物品与损害转化为商品时，情形是一样的：阻碍它们改变身份的，是拒绝在脱离与再附着的工程中继续推进。布列塔尼人拒绝把漏油与一份可识别影响的清单联系起来——那些影响只涉及他们自己，而他们会为此要求金钱补偿。调查得出的结论是：漏油影响了他们
及
其关联环境；不可能在二者之间作出区分。当然，人们可以援引伦理或道德信念、世界观或意识形态，来解释行动者究竟是进入市场行动还是拒绝这样做。然而，这样做会导致忽视或低估那项工作的重要性——相对于这项工作，成功地拒绝只是一个结果。如果物品是过程而非平台，那么所涉及的工作就旨在制造关联；其利害在于脱离与再附着。

Different places, different times, similar problems. The debate over oil spills, even if different, echoes another debate, mentioned above, that took place in Australia. The question there, that of the commercializing of Aboriginal lands, was the following: Were the Aboriginals owners of the lands over which they moved, going from one place to another without settling or putting up fences? In the eyes of Western doctrines, the answer was obviously “no.” The Aboriginals were not settled; they did not cultivate their lands, they did not divide them. The lands were, in a sense, empty entities, pure space-time. Legal experts speak in such cases of
terra nullius
; as is said of the wild boar that roams the scrubland, ignoring fences and barbed wire, it is
res nullius
, a thing without a master.

不同的地方，不同的时代，相似的问题。围绕漏油的争论，尽管有所不同，却与上文提到的、发生在澳大利亚的另一场争论遥相呼应。那里的问题是原住民土地的商品化问题，具体如下：原住民（Aboriginals）是否是他们在其上往来迁徙的那些土地的所有者——他们从一个地方到另一个地方，既不定居，也不设围栏？在西方法学说的眼中，答案显然是“否”。原住民没有定居；他们没有耕作自己的土地，也没有划分土地。从某种意义上说，这些土地是空的实体，是纯粹的空间—时间。法学家在此类情形中谈论“无主之地”（
terra nullius
）；正如人们谈论那头在灌木丛中游荡、无视围栏与铁丝网的野猪时所说，它是“无主物”（
res nullius
），一件没有主人的物。

But why in the world did the Aboriginals not divide their lands? The answer has been given a thousand times. In their eyes, the world is different from what it has become for us. It cannot be reduced to a simple surface or a simple volume with almost geometrical characteristics. In their eyes, the world is only permanent creations and recreations. Populated with people, animals, plants, ritual sites, ancestors, constantly put into movement, living, as it were, it cannot be separated, disentangled, detached from humans. The land does not belong to agents. It is rather the people who belong to the land, engaged in relationships of crossed possession, and not in unilateral property relations.

但原住民究竟为什么没有划分他们的土地呢？答案已经被给出过千百次。在他们眼中，世界与我们如今所面对的世界不同。它不能被化约为一个简单的平面，或一个具有近乎几何学特征的简单体积。在他们眼中，世界只是永恒的创造与再创造。它充满了人、动物、植物、仪式场所、祖先，不断被投入运动，可以说是活生生的，因此不能与人分离、解缠、脱离。土地并不属于行动者。反倒是人属于土地，他们置身于相互交错的占有关系之中，而不是单方面的财产关系之中。

As he recalls this story, John Law adds that one cannot reduce the tension to a mere opposition between diverging visions, for this position only reinforces the hypothesis that what exists is a single world, considered from several angles.

Law further states that whenever one talks of beliefs, conceptions, visions, even if it is to recognize their legitimacy, one is likewise granting that a unique outside world exists and that all people can do is change their way of looking at that world and interpreting it. I wholeheartedly agree with John Law’s perspective, which invites us to reject this solution.

I hesitated for a long time between using an existing word, “passivation,” and creating a neologism, “passiva(c)tion.” I went with the first option in a text published in French in 2013, Michel Callon, “Qu’est-ce qu’un agencement marchand?,” in
Sociologie des agencements marchands: Textes choisis

(Paris: Presse des Mines, 2013), pp. 325– 440. I quickly realized that the term “passivation” was taken up by my few readers or listeners in its usual sense: to make something be unable to act and to reduce it to a purely instrumental role. Indeed, in physical chemistry, passivation refers to a material becoming “passive,” that is, less affected (less corroded) by the environment. Admittedly, they understood that investments are necessary to achieve this result. But they overlooked the other part of the story: to be transformed into commodities, things must be made
active

. It is the reason why I prefer to stick to the word “passiva(c)tion.” If some readers are by chance convinced by my analysis, but are not (yet) ready to use this ugly term, I humbly suggest they adopt the term “passivation,” but warn their readers that they are using it with the more ample meaning I give to “passiva(c)tion.” I thank you in advance for your cooperation!

用益权（usufruct）是一种广泛存在的制度：一方使用另一方的财产而不拥有该财产，但按合同规定对该财产承担某些义务。把用益权与虚有权（bare ownership）分离，使赠与人（例如父母）能够在已经把物品转让出去（例如转让给子女）之后仍继续使用该物品。在这个例子中，对我而言重要的是两项权利可以（并且实际上）分离。这种区分既适用于不动产（例如一套公寓），也适用于动产：股票组合可以按分离两项权利的方式赠予。在这种情况下，享有用益权的人有权出售股份以优化管理，条件是以其他等价的股份予以替换。

A widespread practice, usufruct is a system in which one party uses the property of another without owning, but while bearing certain obligations to the property as spelled out in a contract. Separating usufruct and bare ownership allows the donor (for instance, the parents) to continue to use the good while having transmitted it (for instance, to their children). What matters to me in this example is the possible (and effective) separation of the two rights. The distinction applies to property assets (for example, an apartment) but also to movable assets: a stock portfolio can be given in a way that separates the two rights. In this case, the one who has usufruct is authorized to sell shares to optimize management on condition they are replaced by other equivalent ones.

presence
, in the second case it is
reference
. On the ontological status of these two modes of existence, I refer the reader to Bruno Latour’s foun dational work,

撰写一部货币的谱系学，预设了人们对“货币”一词的含义达成一致；而这种一致远非不言自明，并且迟早可能产生时代错置（anachronism）。对起源的追寻往往导致那些把进步置于首位的叙事；就货币而言，这就意味着认可其日益增长的抽象性。

Writing a genealogy of money presupposes an agreement on what the word “money” means, which is far from obvious and may sooner or later produce anachronisms. The search for origins often leads to narratives that give pride of place to progress, which, in the case of money, means endorsing its growing abstraction.
Bill Maurer, “The Anthropology of Money,”
Annual Review of Anthropology

As we will point out later, those different functions are not given once and for all — they are the outcome of innovations that have been progressively stabilized and disseminated through trial and error. Moreover, they don’t exhaust the possibilities of what money may do.

Debt: The First 5,000 Years,” Anthropological Forum

(Singapore: Springer, 2018), p. 16. This reversal has considerable consequences. The existence of money supposes a rich network of social relations and institutions, whereas barter does not. 在经济学词汇中，（高度的）流动性指可以立即动用的金额，其形式可以是硬币与纸币、银行资产或金融资产。流动性资产较少承受资本损失的风险。还应提到另一项必不可少的属性：可替代性（fungibility），也就是相互替换性。在某些标准化条件下，一公斤银可以被另一公斤银替代，一枚一欧元硬币可以被另一枚一欧元硬币替代，如此等等。容易相互替代，便利了货币向商品的转化。

In the vocabulary of economics (a high degree of) liquidity refers to an amount that is immediately available, which can take the form of coins and notes, bank assets, or financial assets. Liquid assets are less subject to the risk of capital loss. Another property that is essential should also be mentioned: fungibility — that is, substitutability. Under certain conditions of standardization, one kilo of silver can be replaced by another kilo of silver, a one-euro coin by another one-euro coin, and so on. Easy substitutability facilitates the transformation of money into a commodity.

Some authors prefer to use the term “infrastructure” to refer to the assemblages that allow money to function as money. For describing the process of passiva(c)tion, the notion of associated milieu is more appropriate. Both have in common their relative invisibility.

这就解释了为什么人们常常试图把货币的存在与国家或强大的中央行政机构的存在紧密联系起来：二者都能在货币之关联环境的构成中发挥重要作用。国家的主要贡献无疑是促成一种货币的逐渐出现——这种货币在其所治理的领土内被接受，因而更可能较容易地进入商品化过程。

This explains why there have often been attempts to link the existence of money closely to that of the state or a powerful central administration, both of which can play an important role in the constitution of its associated milieu. The main contribution of the state is undoubtedly to promote the gradual emergence of a money that is accepted in the territory it governs and is consequently likely to be more easily engaged into a process of commoditization.

Consider the devices that, in the case of the Catholic religion and in Islam, allow interest rates to be reconciled with religious beliefs and moralities. The Catholic Church used to condemn the principle of interest rates that risk shackling debtors and only finally accepted it in the precise case in which the lender risks not being paid back. (More precisely, interests were authorized by the Scholastics to compensate for a loss endured, the loss of an anticipated profit, the risk of losing loaned capital, or an uncertain profit.) Similarly, Islam considers that the practice of usury (
rîba

) constitutes a very grave sin. In both cases, solutions were imagined that in practice function like loans with interest: the lender can, for instance, become his debtor’s associate, sharing the gains. Protestants showed greater flexibility: Calvin considered it normal that money be productive, just like any other commodity. On these financial practices and their links with theological debates, see Giacomo Todeschini’s seminal book,
I mercanti e il tempio : La società cristiana e il circolo virtuoso della ricchezza fra Medioevo ed étà moderna
(Bologna: Il Mulino, 2002.) See also Pierre Jeannin,
Marchands d’Europe: Pratiques et savoirs à l’epoque moderne
(Paris: Éditions Rue d’Ulm, 2002) and Reinhold C. Mueller,
The Venetian Money Market: Banks, Panics, and the Public Debt
(Baltimore: John Hopkins University Press, 1997).

Dealing in Desire:Asian Ascendancy, Western Decline, and the Hidden Currencies of Global Sex Work

(Berkeley: University of California Press, 2015)。越南的酒吧是复杂的装置，在框定与溢出之间建立起微妙的平衡。作者访谈的陪侍在描述自己为满足客人（其背景与期望千差万别）并促成交易而必须掌握的能力时，坦然承认这一点，并强调她们的工作具有吸引力，因为它使她们摆脱了对雇主的传统从属。Jean Gadrey 对服务提供者作了有趣的分类，区分出三种逻辑。在第一种逻辑中，构成服务的人与技术能力伴随着对受益人自身财产或事务的介入，如顾问或修车厂的情形；在第二种逻辑中，这些能力被提供给受益人使用，如供电或汽车租赁；在第三种逻辑中，受益人参与服务的交付，服务采取表演的形式，如塞纳河游船或游览欧洲迪士尼。Gadrey, “The Characterization of Goods and Services.” 胡志明市的陪侍酒吧混合了第一种与第三种模式：陪侍进行表演（如同欧洲迪士尼的演艺人员），同时像安达信（Arthur Andersen）的任何一位顾问那样，为工业交易作准备。可以设想，驯化将视所涉逻辑的不同而采取不同形式。Jean Gadrey, personal communication。关于服务及其在市场活动中日益增长的地位，参见 Stephen Vargo and Robert Lush, “Evolving to a New Dominant Logic for Marketing,”
Journal of Marketing
68.1 (2004), pp. 1–17; Faïz Gallouj and Faridah Djellal, eds.,
The Handbook of Innovation and Services: A Multidisciplinary Perspective
(Cheltenham:Edward Elgar, 2010)。

Drawing on the analytical framework developed by Viviana Zelizer, Kimberly Kay Hoang shows how in the hostess bars of Ho Chi Minh City, services (notably sexual services) are skillfully framed and formatted. The hostess is free to refuse a request she considers inappropriate. At the same time, however, she must be capable of improvising so that her delivery contributes, in a perfectly consensual and programmed way, to the negotiation of industrial contracts between the clients to whom she provides “assistance”: “No hostesses, no contracts,” admits a businessman. Kimberly Kay Hoang,
Dealing in Desire: Asian Ascendancy, Western Decline, and the Hidden Currencies of Global Sex Work

(Berkeley: University of California Press, 2015). Vietnamese bars are complex devices that establish a subtle equilibrium between framings and overflowings. The hostesses interviewed by the author freely admit it when they describe the competencies they must master in order to satisfy the clients (with widely varying profiles and expectations) and facilitate transactions, emphasizing the appeal of their work because it frees them from traditional subjection to employers. Jean Gadrey offers an interesting classification of service providers by making a distinction between three logics. In the first, human and technical skills that constitute the service are accompanied by an intervention on the beneficiary’s account, as in the case of a consultant or a garage; in the second, these skills are made available to the beneficiary, as in providing electricity or a car rental; in the third, the beneficiary participates in the delivery of the service, which takes the form of a show, as in the case of a cruise on the Seine or a visit to Euro Disney. Gadrey, “The Characterization of Goods and Services.” The hostess bars in Ho Chi Minh City mix the first and the third models: the hostesses put on a show (as do the entertainers at Euro Disney), and they prepare industrial transactions, like any consultant from Arthur Andersen. One can imagine that domestication will take different forms, depending on the logics at play. Jean Gadrey, personal communication.
